title: Software Developer, Mobile Platform
description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers , including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. We're growing fast and hiring the Engineering talent to match. You'd be joining our Mobile team within the Platform Engineering division. We treat our internal developer platform as a real product, with internal customers (our feature teams, 150+ developers) and adoption metrics.The mission for this role: make it dramatically faster and safer to ship mobile features at MaintainX. Today, feature teams reinvent patterns, fight with build infrastructure, and ship slower than they should because the foundations underneath them are inconsistent. We want a mobile foundation where feature teams stop thinking about CI, release trains, shared components, and observability, they just build features. What you’ll do: Design, build, and maintain mobile React Native foundations and tooling powering our internal developer platform. Bring AI native workflows into your daily work and into the platform. Raise engineering excellence standards. Lead to the consolidation and evolution of platform primitives: SDKs, CI pipelines, build tools, local development golden paths. Collaborate with other platform teams and product development teams on defining and adopting the internal developer platform. About you: 4+ years of mobile engineering experience Expert in React Native Proficient building shared modules, SDKs, and reusable components for cross-team use. Strong understanding of Mobile DevOps Strong AI mindset An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align with engineering leaders outside Québec on a daily basis. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com . For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging . More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

title: Staff DevOps Engineer (Platform)
description: Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide. Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone. We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm. This role is fully remote; however, we’re only open to candidates based in the US, EU and UK. Responsibilities SDLC Infrastructure Ownership : Own and evolve CI/CD infrastructure using GitHub Actions and Kubernetes, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and developer velocity. Mobile Release Automation : Automate release workflows including building, signing, and distributing binaries and managing app store submissions across iOS, Android, and Chrome. e2e Test Automation : Oversee and improve automated end-to-end testing with Maestro and Playwright across mobile and web. CI/CD Optimization : Improve pipeline performance, reliability, and observability to support rapid, high-confidence releases. Developer Experience : Partner with engineering teams on SDLC and DevEx improvements, including preview environments and tooling such as Appetize. Security & Compliance : Help ensure build, release, and deployment systems meet the security and compliance expectations of a financial product. Technical Leadership : Set standards and drive improvements across build, test, release, and deployment workflows, partnering closely with product and engineering teams. Qualifications 8+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, Systems Engineering, or a related role, with experience operating at a senior or staff level. Strong experience with AWS and CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI. Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or Pulumi. Experience supporting CI/CD and release infrastructure for production mobile applications, including iOS and Android. Experience working in financial services, fintech, or another environment with meaningful security and compliance requirements. Strong track record of improving developer workflows and partnering across engineering teams. Nice-to-have: Experience with React Native and/or Expo, mobile preview environments, or Appetize. Nice-to-have: Blockchain/crypto experience. Why Work with Us We are a team of experienced builders in the blockchain and crypto industry. Our journey began from users seeking an easy, seamless path to accessing the crypto ecosystem. This passion fueled our exponential growth, allowing us to onboard over 20M+ active users in just over three years; with our user base growing weekly. Our dedication to a secure and seamless user experience has made us the leading wallet on Solana as well as our multi-chain approach enhances our platform's versatility, meeting the needs of a diverse and growing user base. By staying at the forefront of technology and user expectations, we continue to innovate and set industry standards on self-custodial crypto wallets. There has never been a better time to work in crypto to help shape the future of innovation with a focus around the wallet experience! First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem. Make crypto easier to navigate: There is no easy way for a user to discover and navigate all that crypto has to offer. Wallets have a unique opportunity to help users not only onboard to crypto but also stay retained by exploring new things to do. We live in a multi-chain world: We currently support Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin with more networks to come in the new future. We are focused on creating a unified, multi-chain crypto experience for users. Benefits Competitive salary and equity Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision) — 100% covered Stipend for your ideal remote / WFH set-up: laptop, headphones, and any other work gear you may need Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!) 401(k) retirement plan Wellness benefit Daily lunch benefit We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career. By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: We’re Capital on Tap 👋 💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that. Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started! We opened our first Portuguese office in Porto in autumn 2025, and in less than a year it has grown to a team of 50. Lisbon is the next step. We're opening our first office in the city and looking for engineers to join as founding members of the team, helping shape how we build, hire and work here from day one. 🏡🏢 The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site. Salary: €55,000-70,000 This is a multiple-headcount role, so please don't be put off if you've seen it advertised for a while. What You’ll Be Doing We’re looking for Senior Full stack Engineers to help us build the best credit card and payment products for small businesses. If you’re looking for an environment where you’re given the freedom to make empowered decisions, research new technologies, and learn/share knowledge with your peers. Then keep on reading! You’ll build robust and scalable solutions using .Net technology From the first line of code to production, monitoring, and continuous improvement - you’ll own the SDLC You’ll craft slick, responsive user interfaces with modern JavaScript frameworks (React), making sure our products don’t just work, they feel great to use Teamwork makes the dream work - you’ll partner with Product Managers, QA’s, and fellow Software Engineers You’ll build bulletproof unit and integration tests to keep our software sharp and our users happy Bugs happen. When they do, you’ll be ready to troubleshoot and tweak as needed You’ll bridge the gap between tech speak and business goals, ensuring everyone’s on the same page and moving forward together We’re Looking For 🔎 Required skills: A minimum of 5+ years hands-on experience in C#, .Net Core, SQL Server, ideally JavaScript and React also! Good testing practices, in both Unit and Integration testing Good understanding of database technologies Experience in using Agile development practices A passion for learning new skills and technologies A proactive, supportive, and collaborative team player Our Tech Stack Backend: C#, .Net, .Net Core Frontend: React, JavaScript Mobile: Flutter, Dart Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB Cloud: Azure & GCP Interview Process 🤝 First stage: 30-minute intro, CV review, and values with a Talent Partner Second stage: 45-minute “Tech Chat” with a Team Manager Final stage: 90-minute Code Pairing + 30-minute Values Interview Diversity & Inclusion 🌈 We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work. Great Work Deserves Great Perks Check out our benefits: 🏥 Private Healthcare through AdvanceCare 🎁 Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical) 🏖️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend) 📖 Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget 💬 6 free therapy sessions per year 🍫 Free drinks and snacks in our offices Other Info 👍Check out our ‘Top Tips’ for interviewing. ✔️Keep updated on new job opportunities by following us on Linkedin . 📧Email careers@capitalontap.com if you have any questions. Excited to work here? Apply! If you’d like to progress your career within our fast growing, profitable fintech then click apply and we will aim to get back to you within 3 working days (during busy periods this could take up to 5 working days.)

title: Sr. Technical Account Manager
description: AI at Zapier At Zapier , we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently . Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process , including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to. Job posted: 8/28/2026 Location: Remote Canada, Central & South America- Pacific Time (PST) working hours required Hi there! Zapier’s mission is to make automation work for everyone, helping people eliminate repetitive work and focus on what matters most. We’re looking for a Senior Technical Account Manager to support our Enterprise customers on the post-sale team. You’ll serve as a named senior technical partner to builders, technical leaders, and executives, helping them turn important business problems into reliable, well-designed automations. You’ll join a growing team of four Sr TAMs reporting to a Senior Manager. Customer portfolios vary by program, account size, technical complexity, and level of engagement. Customers typically receive an average allocation of approximately six dedicated TAM hours, which you’ll use for architecture, hands-on building, technical enablement, and proactive account planning. You’ll design architectures, build and improve workflows, solve complex technical problems, and strengthen the resilience of customers’ automation systems. In partnership with Customer Success, you’ll connect this work to adoption, customer value, retention, and growth. You’ll also represent the customer internally, giving Product and Engineering clear insight into product gaps, critical bugs, and opportunities to improve the Enterprise experience. Our Commitment to Applicants Culture and Values at Zapier Zapier Guide to Remote Work Zapier Code of Conduct Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier Things You’ll Do Design, build, and improve customer automations Use customers’ dedicated TAM hours to design, build, and improve automations tied to meaningful business outcomes. Translate complex processes into practical workflow architectures covering data movement, business logic, exception paths, and operational controls. Build alongside customer teams to move high-value use cases from concept to reliable production operation. Review existing automations for reliability, efficiency, maintainability, and effective use of Zapier. Troubleshoot issues across Zapier, APIs, authentication, data formats, and connected applications. Identify recurring failures and improve error handling, monitoring, alerts, fallback behavior, and recovery processes. Lead proactive technical partnerships Develop a strong understanding of each customer’s priorities, systems, technical constraints, governance needs, and automation maturity. Create technical account plans that identify valuable use cases, architectural recommendations, risks, and next steps. Lead working sessions, architecture reviews, implementation discussions, and executive conversations. Use sound judgment to determine when to solve directly, teach the customer, recommend another approach, or involve additional Zapier teams. Drive customer and team outcomes through internal partnership Partner closely with Customer Success to connect technical priorities to adoption, realized value, retention, and growth. Bring technical evidence into account planning, business reviews, renewal preparation, and expansion conversations. Surface blockers, adoption gaps, and architectural risks early, and take ownership of moving the right people toward a solution. Proactively identify and lead team or cross-functional initiatives, turning recurring needs into scalable solutions, reusable practices, and better experiences for customers and the team. Represent the customer inside Zapier Give Product and Engineering technically grounded feedback that explains the customer’s use case, business impact, urgency, and available workarounds. Use evidence and patterns across your portfolio to advocate for fixes and features that materially affect Enterprise customers. Coordinate complex escalations, keep customers informed, and set clear expectations. Share recurring insights that improve the product, documentation, supportability, and broader Enterprise experience. Help customers make sound AI decisions AI is changing how customers design and operate automations. You’ll help them move beyond surface-level terminology and make responsible implementation choices. Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini in your own work, applying appropriate review, verification, and judgment. Understand meaningful differences among AI models and discuss their capabilities, limitations, and selection criteria credibly with customers. Explain the difference between deterministic automation, AI-assisted workflows, and agentic systems, and help customers decide when and how to use each. Guide practical conversations about accuracy, reliability, evaluation, fallback behavior, human oversight, security, and governance. Understand emerging AI integration patterns, including the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and how models, tools, data, and automation platforms can work together. What We’re Looking For Significant experience (7+ years) in technical account management, solutions architecture, customer engineering, sales engineering, implementation consulting, or a comparable customer-facing technical role. A track record of measurably improving customer outcomes across an Enterprise portfolio, for example, reducing churn risk, strengthening renewals, expanding adoption, or creating upsell and cross-sell opportunities through technical enablement. Demonstrated experience building integrations, automations, or API-based solutions, not only recommending them. Hands-on familiarity with Zapier or comparable automation and integration platforms. Experience owning complex technical relationships with Enterprise customers and communicating effectively with both builders and executives. A track record of building integrations, automations, or API-based solutions, not only recommending them. Strong working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, authentication, structured data, application integrations, and conditional workflow logic. The ability to diagnose ambiguous, multi-system problems and design for production reliability, monitoring, recovery, and maintainability. Strong customer judgment, balancing immediate needs with technical feasibility, risk, scale, and long-term value. The ability to operate autonomously in an ambiguous environment: proactively identifying high-impact work, driving customer and team initiatives to completion across multiple internal teams. Hands-on experience with AI tools and a practical understanding of AI-assisted workflows, agentic systems, evaluation, oversight, and governance. How to Apply At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional. Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process. After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter! Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here . Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com . Application Deadline: The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled. Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

title: Security Engineer, Detection & Response
description: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand. Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence. The Liftoff Security team protects Liftoff's customers, users, and employees. We architect Liftoff's security posture, build the tools and systems that defend it, and partner with engineering teams as they ship new products and features. Our work spans the entire stack — infrastructure, web, mobile, and IT — and we approach security from a software engineering standpoint, scaling our impact through automation and well-designed tools. Now is the time to join! Here's why: Build out our detection and response function. Liftoff has a mature security information and event management platform (SIEM), established detection content, and a working incident response program. Your charter is to take it to the next level — including leading our investment in AI-augmented SOC tooling. High visibility, high impact. Detection and response is a critical capability for Liftoff. Security-conscious engineering culture. Liftoff's engineering org is a willing and capable partner on security work. Hands-on technical work. Stay deep in code, detections, and incidents. Breadth of work. Detection and response is the primary focus, but you'll partner across the security team on cloud, infrastructure, and application security where the work demands it. Large-scale, interesting systems. Liftoff processes millions of requests per second across its demand-side platform (DSP), mobile software development kit (SDK), and ad exchange. Responsibilities: Own day-to-day operation of Liftoff's SIEM (Panther) — log source ingestion, detection content, and the alert investigation pipeline. Lead Liftoff's adoption of AI-augmented SOC tooling (e.g. Prophet, Dropzone, or equivalent) as a multi-year modernization investment. Triage incoming security alerts and drive timely investigation and remediation with stakeholders across Engineering and IT. Lead incident response — investigation, containment, and post-incident review — and mature processes and runbooks so response becomes predictable and repeatable. Build tooling and automation that detects active threats, enriches alerts, and reduces manual investigation toil. Partner with Engineering and IT to make detection and response self-service where possible — clear log-onboarding paths, documented detection proposals, accessible runbooks — so security scales without becoming a bottleneck. Close the feedback loop between the team's offensive and proactive findings and detection coverage. Partner across the security team on cloud, infrastructure, and application security work alongside your detection and response focus — every engineer on this team covers breadth beyond their primary focus. Participate in the Security team's on-call rotation and incident response. Minimum Qualifications: 5+ years in security engineering, security operations, detection engineering, or software engineering with a security focus. Hands-on production SIEM operation — onboarding log sources, writing and maintaining detection content, and triaging alerts. Write production-quality code for security automation and detection-as-code. Experience leading or substantially contributing to security incident response. Strong technical writing — design docs, runbooks, and post-incident reviews. Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing security work using a risk-based approach. Ability to quickly navigate large, unfamiliar codebases and reason about complex engineering systems. Excellent verbal communication. Willing to participate in an on-call rotation. Desirable Qualifications: Hands-on experience with an AI-augmented SOC platform (Prophet Security, Dropzone AI, or equivalent), or with building large language model (LLM) augmented investigation and runbook tooling. title: Team Lead Software Engineer
description: We’re Capital on Tap 👋 💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. Lisbon is the next step. We're opening our first office in the city and looking for engineers to join as founding members of the team, helping shape how we build, hire and work here from day one. 🏢The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site. Salary: €70,000 - 90,000 What You’ll Be Doing We're looking for an Engineering Team Lead to lead one of our product engineering teams here at Capital on Tap. This is a people-first leadership role. You won't be the best coder in the room you'll be the person who makes the whole room better. If you're an experienced Team Lead Engineer looking to own a team in a scaling fintech, this role is built for you. What You'll Own Your team. Hiring, developing, and retaining engineers. Running 1:1s that actually matter. Spotting who's ready to grow and creating the space for them to do it. Delivery. Partnering with Product and QA to plan and ship reliably not by micromanaging, but by removing obstacles, managing risk, and keeping the team focused on what matters. Culture. Setting the tone for how the team communicates, gives feedback, and holds itself accountable. Building psychological safety without sacrificing standards. Technical credibility. You won't be heads-down in the codebase every day, but you'll understand the trade-offs your team is navigating architecture decisions, technical debt, build vs buy and contribute meaningfully to those conversations. What We're Looking For Leadership first. You've managed engineers before and have a point of view on what good looks like. You know how to have hard conversations, give developmental feedback, and motivate people. Technical foundation in .NET. Our backend is C#/.NET Core and you'll need enough depth to earn trust with your engineers, review decisions, and spot risks. You don't need to be across every layer of the stack you need to be honest about what you know and curious about what you don't. Product mindset. You think about engineering in the context of business outcomes, not just technical correctness. You can push back on scope, advocate for quality, and translate between engineering and non-technical stakeholders. Comfort with ambiguity. Capital on Tap is growing. Priorities shift. We want someone who creates clarity for their team rather than waiting for it. Nice to Have Experience with Azure cloud development Familiarity with React or other frontend frameworks Background in financial services or fintech Diversity & Inclusion 🌈 We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Filiz est une startup SaaS de 30 personnes qui digitalise aujourd'hui les contrats d'apprentissage en France et construit son deuxième produit : un ERP nouvelle génération pour transformer la façon dont les établissements d'enseignement supérieur opèrent au quotidien. Depuis 2025, Filiz est accompagnée par Hexa, le startup studio français derrière des succès de licornes comme Spendesk, Aircall et Front. Nous attaquons un marché immense, encore largement à réinventer. Le premier produit est en production, les clients sont là. Maintenant, nous entrons dans une nouvelle phase : construire un produit ambitieux, sortir de France et bâtir la référence européenne des outils pour l'enseignement supérieur. Nous cherchons un(e) Senior Software Engineer capable de prendre l'ownership d'un produit, d'une architecture et d'un domaine technique, tout en restant profondément hands-on. Le poste n'a pas de management hiérarchique : ton impact passe par le code, les choix d'architecture et la montée en compétence de l'équipe. Intégré au sein d’une équipe, tu travailleras principalement sur l'ERP, encore en construction : tu participeras à le concevoir et à l'amener jusqu'à la production. Le produit historique reste en production et l'équipe continue de le faire vivre. Ce que tu vas faire chez nous Build & Run de A à Z : tu conçois et fais évoluer des features end-to-end : design, développement, releases et suivi en production. Hands-on & design : tu codes, refactores et améliores l'existant. Tu participes à l'architecture avec le CTO et poses les bases d'un système capable de scaler. PR review & excellence technique : tu élèves le niveau de l'équipe en challengeant le code, la modélisation, les cas limites et la maintenabilité. Intégrations robustes : tu construis des APIs et des systèmes résilients adaptés à des contraintes métier fortes. Fiabilité & observabilité : tu conçois des systèmes capables de détecter et prévenir les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent les utilisateurs. Leadership technique : tu accompagnes les développeurs de l'équipe, partages tes pratiques et fais grandir les personnes autour de toi. Ce qui t'attend techniquement Stack : TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, monorepo Turborepo Observabilité : Sentry, BetterStack, OpenTelemetry Façon de travailler : Kanban, sans sprint. On livre en petits incréments et on deploy plusieurs fois par jour Profil recherché 6+ ans d'expérience avec une expérience prouvée sur des produits en production utilisés par de vrais utilisateurs. Tu as déjà construit et opéré un backend dans la durée. Tu connais les compromis d'une architecture qui doit tenir dans le temps. Tu es capable de couvrir tout le cycle : compréhension du produit, system design, développement, déploiement et run. Tu as le réflexe des cas limites. La dette technique existe, elle est nommée et priorisée : tu préfères faire progresser le produit plutôt que de viser une perfection théorique. Tu utilises l'IA au quotidien et tu veux participer à construire nos pratiques et nos outils, pas seulement coder plus vite. Tu as déjà joué un rôle de Tech Lead : ownership d'un système, décisions d'architecture et accompagnement d'autres développeurs. title: Senior Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
description: About us Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. About the team The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents. Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services. All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down. The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on-call. About you You're a senior engineer who wants to own features end to end, not just close tickets. You've built and run production Python services, ideally high-traffic or latency-sensitive ones, and you've been on-call for them. value="2">Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect value="4">Own onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development for new specialists through documentation, shadowing, and direct feedback on work quality.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate interviews, prepare satisfaction, specialist response times, scheduling turnaround, and data accuracy to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and risks.</li> <li value="7">Partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global coordination process, contribute regional evidence to process and tooling improvements, implement agreed changes, and keep documentation accurate in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting coordination, covering interview scheduling, offer and contract preparation, background checks, and onboarding handoffs, including serving as a senior or go-to team member.</li> <li value="2">Ability to lead and develop team members without formal authority through mentoring, onboarding, direct feedback, and influence.</li> <li value="3">Attention to detail in scheduling, contracts, and candidate data, with a record of professionalism, responsiveness, sound judgment under pressure, and maintaining confidentiality.</li> <li value="4">Experience anticipating risks, resolving scheduling and process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.</li> <li value="6">Experience working across regions or functions to standardize processes, with the judgment to distinguish genuine regional requirements from inconsistent practices.</li> <li value="7">Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and stakeholders at all levels, including title: Senior Growth Product Manager
description: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo. The Role You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work. Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked. We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging. What You'll Do Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them. Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads. Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first. Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own. Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them. Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers. Hiring Process Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work) 15-minute phone screen First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem Culture fit (45 min) We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly. Requirements You Should Have 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work. Product craft and taste : you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX. An AI-native way of working and building : you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change. You do your own analysis : you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything. Experience with technical products : you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs. Clear writing and comfort working async : we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English. The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply. Good to Have Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience. Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises. Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working. Benefits What We Offer Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity. Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position. Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one. In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team. All the tokens you need, across all frontier models. Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries. Our Values We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions. ❤️ Why you will love to join Soda You own the adoption metrics : you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it. Lots of room to improve : we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far. Your own engineering team : you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly. Be part of a transformation : data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it. Work on your own terms : fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries. 😡 What you might not love Rapidly changing priorities : our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done. Small numbers : we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating. No playbook : this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda. title: Solution Consulting Manager
description: What We Do Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight. Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG. We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI. Who We Are Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility. The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for. Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan. Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software. The Role We have grown quickly, and our Solution Consulting team is at the center of how prospects evaluate Rillet as their next ERP. We are looking for a Solution Consulting Manager to lead and scale that team. This is a player-coach role weighted heavily toward coaching. You will spend roughly 25% of your time running your own sales cycles (staying sharp, credible and close to the customer and product) and roughly 75% of your time coaching, mentoring and developing your team , primarily by riding shotgun on live deals and giving real-time feedback. You will also be a key voice in shaping the product and building the Solution Consulting infrastructure that lets the organization scale. You will work directly with the CEO, GTM leadership and the Product team. Responsibilities Coach, mentor and develop the team (~75%) Ride shotgun on deals. Join discovery calls, demos, technical validations and POCs to observe, step in when needed, and give specific, real-time feedback. Run tight pre-call prep and post-call debriefs so every deal is a learning opportunity. Raise the bar on craft. Coach Solution Consultants on discovery, value selling, storytelling, demo design, handling technical objections, and tailoring sandbox environments to each customer's use cases. Grow each person individually. Set clear expectations and development plans, give regular honest feedback, and help each Solution Consultant build deep product and accounting domain expertise and advance in their career. Hire and onboard. Recruit, interview and ramp new Solution Consultants, and build an onboarding program that gets them deal-ready quickly. Partner on deal strategy. Work with Account Executives and sales leadership to staff deals, pressure-test strategy on complex ERP evaluations, and keep technical wins on track. Run your own sales cycles (~25%) Remove technical objections. Take on strategic and complex opportunities, understanding the prospect's business requirements and existing technology stack, and clearly articulating how Rillet integrates and improves their processes. Deliver high-impact demos. Set up and tailor the sandbox environment, answer questions in real time, and act as the prospect's trusted consultant throughout the purchase process. Represent Rillet. Be the face of the company, applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is excellent, including with finance and accounting leaders. Inform product and build for scale Be the voice of the prospect. Synthesize front-line feedback, objections, competitive intel and feature gaps from across the team, and bring it to founders and Product in close to real time, with clear patterns and prioritization. Influence the roadmap. Partner with Product on discovery, early feedback on new features, and how capabilities are positioned and demoed. Build Solution Consulting infrastructure. Create the systems, playbooks and tools that help the team scale, such as discovery frameworks, demo standards and reusable assets, sandbox and demo-data templates, technical FAQs and objection libraries, POC and technical-validation processes, a deal-review cadence, and enablement and certification paths. Measure what matters. Define and track team metrics (technical win rate, ramp time, deal coverage, cycle time) and use them to improve how the team operates. Qualifications 2+ years managing or formally mentoring pre-sales, solutions consulting or sales engineering teams, with a track record of developing people. 3+ years of industry accounting experience across areas such as revenue recognition, month-end close and multi-entity consolidation. 3+ years supporting complex ERP sales cycles with implementation and/or customer support for accounting or financial solutions. Deep knowledge of the ecosystem of tools in the office of the CFO. Excellent communicator who makes complex concepts easy to understand, and who can give direct, constructive feedback in the moment. Experience building processes, enablement or tooling for a growing team, ideally in an early-stage, fast-moving environment. Thrives in a dynamic environment while keeping high attention to detail. CPA certification or having started your career in audit is a plus. Note : All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @ rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam. Life at Rillet Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales. Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create. Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals. Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings. Compensation: $210K – $320K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges Zone A • OTE $225K – $320K • Offers Equity Zone B • OTE $210K – $290K • Offers Equity Zone C • OTE $210K – $290K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Growth Product Manager
description: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo. The Role You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work. Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked. We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging. What You'll Do Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them. Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads. Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first. Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own. Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them. Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers. Hiring Process Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work) 15-minute phone screen First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem Culture fit (45 min) We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly. Requirements You Should Have 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work. Product craft and taste : you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX. An AI-native way of working and building : you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change. You do your own analysis : you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything. Experience with technical products : you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs. Clear writing and comfort working async : we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English. The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply. Good to Have Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience. Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises. Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working. Benefits What We Offer Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity. Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position. Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one. In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team. All the tokens you need, across all frontier models. Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries. Our Values We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions. ❤️ Why you will love to join Soda You own the adoption metrics : you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it. Lots of room to improve : we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far. Your own engineering team : you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly. Be part of a transformation : data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it. Work on your own terms : fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries. 😡 What you might not love Rapidly changing priorities : our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done. Small numbers : we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating. No playbook : this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda. title: Senior Product Manager, Secret Detection and Vulnerability Research
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a <strong>Senior Product Manager</strong>, you will own GitLab's Secret Detection offering and the Vulnerability Research function that produces the detection content across security products. Secret Detection is one of the highest-signal, highest-volume security capabilities on the platform. Leaked credentials are the most common initial access vector in real breaches, and as AI agents write, commit, and configure more of the software, the surface area for exposed secrets grows faster than the number of humans watching it.</p> <p>You will own the full loop: detect a secret with high precision, tell the customer whether it is still live, get it revoked, and prevent the next one from ever landing. In parallel, you will own vulnerability research as a product asset rather than a back-office function. The detection rules, advisory data, and malicious package and reference intelligence your team produces are what make GitLab's security scanners worth paying for, and they need to ship on a cadence with measurable quality.</p> <p>This is an outcome-owning role - you will carry adoption, retention, and revenue targets for your area and be expected to explain how your roadmap moves them.</p> <p><strong>Some examples of our projects:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Push protection and pre-receive blocking that stops a credential before it reaches a repository, without wrecking developer flow</li> <li>Secret validity checking and automated revocation partnerships with major cloud and SaaS token issuers</li> <li>Detection content pipelines that turn threat research into shipped rules, with precision and recall tracked per rule</li> <li>Intelligence-driven detection of malicious packages, dependencies, and references entering the software supply chain</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own</strong> the business outcomes for Secret Detection and Vulnerability Research, including adoption, expansion, competitive win rate, and revenue contribution. Bring a point of view on packaging and pricing, not just features.</li> <li><strong>Set</strong> the strategy for the full secret lifecycle: prevention, detection, validation, revocation, and reporting across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed.</li> <li><strong>Treat</strong> detection content as a product. Define how rules, advisories, and intelligence feeds are sourced, validated, versioned, and measured, and make quality visible to customers.</li> <li><strong>Hold</strong> the line on detection quality. False positives are a product defect and you will own the metrics that prove precision is improving.</li> <li><strong>Work</strong> at the level of the technology. Read the rule syntax, question the entropy heuristics, understand why a scanner missed something, and challenge engineering with informed alternatives.</li> <li><strong>Use</strong> AI to compress the distance between question and answer. Pull your own data, prototype your own flows, synthesize research and competitive input yourself, and bring conclusions rather than requests for someone else to investigate.</li> <li><strong>Build</strong> the case for where AI belongs in the product: triage, rule generation, remediation guidance, and reducing the human review burden per finding.</li> <li><strong>Partner</strong> with engineering, security research, threat intelligence, Field, and GitLab's own Security team, who are one of your most demanding users.</li> <li><strong>Communicate</strong> in writing, asynchronously, with enough precision that a distributed team can act without a meeting.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Domain depth</strong> in application security, vulnerability management, or security research. You have worked on or adjacent to scanners, detection content, threat intelligence, or SDLC security tooling and you know how these products actually get evaluated in a bake-off.</li> <li><strong>Technical credibility</strong> sufficient to earn the respect of a security engineering team. You do not need to have written the scanner, but you should be able to reason about detection logic, data pipelines, CI integration, and the tradeoffs between coverage and noise.</li> <li><strong>Commercial reasoning.</strong> You start from revenue mechanics, buyer motion, and competitive displacement, then work inward to product decisions. Candidates who reason only from feature lists outward are not a fit.</li> <li><strong>Evidence of using AI as a force multiplier</strong> in your own work: research, analysis, data pulls, prototyping, drafting. Consuming a chat assistant occasionally is not the same as restructuring how you work.</li> <li><strong>Judgment under ambiguity.</strong> You bring structured options and a recommendation instead of escalating an open question.</li> <li><strong>Bias for clarity.</strong> You can take a noisy, technical, politically contested problem and produce one page that everyone can align on.</li> <li><strong>Bonus:</strong> hands-on background as a developer, security engineer, red teamer, or researcher; experience with credential and token ecosystems; experience commercializing a data or intelligence asset.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>This role sits in GitLab's Security product management organization, which owns application security testing, vulnerability management, supply chain security, secrets management, and AI governance. The Security Section is central to GitLab's Ultimate tier and to the shift toward consumption-based product revenue, so the work is visible to senior leadership and directly tied to company results. You will work asynchronously with engineering, design, and research counterparts across multiple regions, and with the Field teams who take this to market.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Outbound Growth Associate
description: Who We Are: SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company. We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. Job Summary: We are seeking a highly strategic Outbound Growth Associate to design the foundational go-to-market (GTM) playbooks supporting our Enterprise team. Rather than executing standard outbound volume, this role requires deep independent judgment to evaluate, and implement advanced AI powered growth strategies. As a founding member of our growth team, you will design the operational playbooks, test automated frameworks, and act as a strategic partner alongside internal marketing leadership and external advisors to drive SmithRx’s growth engine. Excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable presenting strategy to HR/Benefits leaders, CFOs, and outside consultants. description: About Keyrock Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York. We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management. We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement. We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it. What we are looking for We are seeking a Head of Risk to own and develop the Firm’s risk function end-to-end. This is a senior leadership role with direct accountability for the design, implementation and enforcement of a Firm-wide risk framework across all activities. The role requires strong quantitative risk expertise and the ability to apply rigorous methodologies to complex, real-time markets across both traditional finance and digital assets. The successful candidate will co-design the firm’s risk architecture with the COO and CIO, covering data, analytics and real-time risk aggregation. You will have full oversight of risk across trading (spot and derivatives), treasury and investments, including exposures across CeFi and DeFi environments. This includes defining risk appetite, implementing advanced risk metrics and ensuring disciplined risk-taking across the organization. We are looking for a leader who sets the standard, challenges the business and enforces a strong risk culture, while enabling the firm to scale. Role description Quantitative Risk Framework: Develop and maintain a quantitative risk framework grounded in modern risk theory (e.g. market, credit, liquidity and systemic risk modelling), leveraging concepts such as tail risk, extreme value theory, dependence structures and stress testing Firm-wide Risk System Architecture: Co-design and implement the Firm-wide risk management system in close collaboration with the COO and CIO, including data architecture, risk aggregation layers, real-time monitoring capabilities and reporting infrastructure across all business lines. Cross-Asset & Cross-Infrastructure Risk Integration: Build an integrated risk view across centralized and decentralized venues, covering exchange risk, counterparty risk, smart contract risk, collateral efficiency and liquidity fragmentation. Advanced Risk Modelling & Metrics: Define and implement advanced risk metrics (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress scenarios, liquidity-adjusted risk, concentration risk) and ensure their consistent application across trading, treasury and investment activities. Is plus: TradFi ↔ Crypto Risk Translation: Translate traditional financial risk methodologies into crypto-native environments, adapting models to account for 24/7 markets, fragmented liquidity, funding dynamics, on-chain transparency and new failure modes (e.g. oracle risk, protocol risk). Background and Experience Quantitative Risk Expertise: Strong foundation in quantitative risk management, including hands-on experience with market risk, credit risk and liquidity risk modelling, ideally aligned with frameworks such as those presented in Quantitative Risk Management (McNeil, Frey, Embrechts) . Modelling & Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to design and implement risk models, including tail risk estimation, scenario analysis, stress testing frameworks and dependence modelling across asset classes. System Design & Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience in designing or co-designing firm-wide risk systems, working closely with technology (CIO) and operations (COO) to translate risk requirements into scalable infrastructure. TradFi + Crypto Hybrid Experience: Experience operating at the intersection of traditional financial markets and digital assets (CeFi and/or DeFi), with a strong understanding of differences in market structure, risk transmission and infrastructure. Crypto-Specific Risk Understanding: Practical knowledge of crypto-specific risks, including exchange/custodian risk, smart contract risk, protocol risk, funding/basis dynamics and collateral management in both centralized and decentralized environments. Competences and personality Strong drive and proactivity to continuously strengthen the risk management in a fast-growing financial institution The candidate reports to the COO but this is not a reporting role, but a quantitative risk management system-building role. Our recruitment philosophy We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility. Our offer A competitive salary and global benefit package Annual Team Retreats: a yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities Autonomy in your time management thanks to semi-flexible working hours= Fast-paced, highly intellectually stimulating working environment The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence Keyrock offers you both a career and a large range of benefits that we will gladly discuss in the course of the application process. As an employer we are committed to building an inclusive, diverse and non-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

title: Compliance Officer / MLRO Switzerland & Liechtenstein

title: Accident & Health Claims Handler

<section class="block team"> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>The Solutions Architecture team sits within GitLab Sales and partners with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product to help customers
