title: Corporate Development Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2 id="an-overview-of-this-role" data-lfile-container="21ea07e5-ded4-47e8-ad92-4ca7b7d6be35" data-pm-slice="1 1 []">An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Corporate Development Director, you'll help influence how GitLab invests to win: what we build, what we buy, where we partner, and what we should not pursue. This role sits within the Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships team, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships.</p> <p>This role straddles strategy and M&A engagements. You'll lead research that frames GitLab's options: mapping the markets in and around our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, testing where we have a right to win, and turning that into clear recommendations for the executive team. When the answer is to acquire, you'll drive the deal process end to end, from outreach through close and integration.</p> <p>Success here is not measured by deal count. It looks like sharper strategic choices: a well-reasoned point of view on our priority markets, investment theses that product and executive leaders rely on, acquisitions that speed up the roadmap when buying is the right answer, and an educated no when it isn't. You'll own the wider market perspective rather than individual product categories, and work with the team's Analyst on the research behind it.</p> <h2 id="what-youll-do">What you'll do</h2> <h3 id="strategy-and-research">Strategy and research</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the wider market view.</strong> Research the broader market GitLab competes in, beyond specific product categories: competitive dynamics, AI-native entrants, technology shifts and where value is moving. Collaborate with the team's Analyst on the research and turn the findings into a clear point of view on where GitLab should play.</li> <li><strong>Build an investment thesis for each focus area.</strong> Work with Product and Engineering leaders to define the problems worth solving, the capabilities GitLab needs, and what it would cost in time and money to get there on our own.</li> <li><strong>Own the competitive and landscape view.</strong> Maintain market maps and a current read on GitLab's competitors: their strategy, product direction, positioning, pricing, and M&A and funding activity. Produce competitor analyses that show where we lead, where we're exposed and how rivals are likely to move. Flag shifts by competitors, hyperscalers and AI labs that change our options, and bring the implications to Product and the executive team.</li> <li><strong>Define where GitLab should not play.</strong> Identify adjacencies that dilute focus and markets where the economics or competition work against us. Make the case for a no with the same rigor as a yes.</li> </ul> <h3 id="build-buy-or-partner">Build, buy or partner</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Run the build, buy, partner analysis.</strong> For each strategic gap, compare the options side by side on speed, cost, risk, control and strategic fit, and bring a clear recommendation.</li> <li><strong>Deliver strategic clarity to</strong> <strong>executives and the Board.</strong> Produce short strategy memos/decks and business cases that set out the decision, the trade-offs and what we give up with each path.</li> <li><strong>Feed company strategy and planning.</strong> Bring an outside-in view of the market and the inorganic options available into annual and long-range planning.</li> <li><strong>Work hand in hand with Strategic Partnerships.</strong> When partnering is the right answer, frame the opportunity and hand it to the partnership owner with a clear thesis. When it isn't, explain why.</li> </ul> <h3 id="deal-execution-and-integration">Deal execution and integration</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own end-to-end deal process management.</strong> Validate target fit against GitLab's our target profile, product roadmap and other criteria, and build the acquisition rationale and business case. Drive our M&A process from intro call through the various steps through to closing and integration.</li> <li><strong>Evaluate the deal.</strong> Develop valuation, commercial integrity assessment, impact on GitLab's business and provide negotiations assistance to the VP and the executive team.</li> <li><strong>Lead cross-functional diligence.</strong> Run pre-LOI validation and diligence across Product, Engineering, Security, Finance, Legal and People, and communicate findings clearly.</li> <li><strong>Drive deal documents with Legal.</strong> Prepare NDAs, LOIs and purchase agreements with GitLab Legal and outside counsel.</li> <li><strong>Own integration outcomes.</strong> Lead post-acquisition integration as the DRI, measured against the roadmap and business goals in the business case. Bring lessons learned back into the strategy work.</li> <li><strong>Build the external network.</strong> Maintain relationships with founders, executives, investors, bankers and advisors that bring us early insight and pipeline.</li> </ul> <h2 id="what-youll-bring">What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and deal experience.</strong> 8+ years across corporate development, corporate strategy, strategy consulting or technology investing, including 5+ years leading acquisitions end to end in enterprise software.</li> <li><strong>Structured strategic thinking.</strong> You form a point of view from incomplete information, test it against data, and change your mind when the evidence says so. title: Senior Clinical Research Associate
description: <p>At Precision for Medicine, we are always looking to connect with exceptional talents, and we are currently seeking <strong>Senior Clinical Research Associates</strong> in <strong>Poland, Hungary, United Kingdom, France and Germany</strong> to support a dedicated <strong>FSP partnership</strong>, working closely with a strategic sponsor in a highly collaborative and quality-focused environment. </p> <p>This evergreen posting is part of our ongoing talent pipeline strategy and enables interested candidates to be considered for future opportunities aligned with upcoming project requirements. While there may not be an immediate opening, candidates whose experience matches our anticipated needs will be considered for future opportunities as they arise.</p> <p>This position can be offered fully home-based within Germany. </p> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are calm, thoughtful, and responsive when things don’t go as planned.</li> <li>You are well-prepared, whether it be for an investigator meeting, site visit or project team update, always staying two steps ahead of the game.</li> <li>You find quick and creative ways of overcoming difficulties.</li> <li>You have an impeccable eye for detail.</li> <li>You identify potential study risks and propose solutions on how to mitigate them.</li> <li>You take responsibility in the quality and outcomes of your work.</li> <li>You are adept at handling conflict by using tried and true resolution strategies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How we will keep you busy and support your growth:</strong></p> <p>You will monitor and own the progress of clinical studies at investigative sites and ensure that clinical studies are conducted, recorded, and reported per protocol, SOPs, ICH-GCP, and all applicable regulations and standards. description: Möchtest du den Arbeitsalltag von Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Frankreich und Europa aktiv mitgestalten? Fühlst du dich in einem vertrauensvollen und dynamischen Umfeld wohl? Dann könnte Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich sein, und du könntest perfekt zu dieser Rolle passen 🙂 Unsere Vision Wir möchten das beliebteste Financial Operating System für europäische KMU werden. Wir helfen Unternehmer:innen, den zeitaufwendigen Aufwand rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu reduzieren. Gleichzeitig erhalten sie Zugang zu wichtigen Informationen, die sie dabei unterstützen, bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen. Auch Steuerkanzleien profitieren davon. Mit Pennylane können sie manuelle und repetitive Aufgaben reduzieren und mehr Zeit in die Beratung und Begleitung ihrer Mandant:innen investieren. Über uns Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintech-Unternehmen in Frankreich, und wir beschleunigen derzeit unser Wachstum in Deutschland 🇩🇪 Seit unserer Gründung vor sechs Jahren ist es uns gelungen: 💻 Uns als wegweisende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerkanzleien zu etablieren 💰 Insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro aufzunehmen, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem bekannten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe und PayPal investiert hat 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Von sieben Gründer:innen auf mehr als 1.200 Mitarbeitende zu wachsen. Heute gelten wir als einer der besten Arbeitgeber in Frankreich und bieten zudem zahlreiche Remote-Arbeitsmöglichkeiten. Auf Glassdoor haben wir eine Bewertung von 4,6/5. 🌍 Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten und einer stark remote-freundlichen Kultur aufzubauen. Bereits 30 % unserer Mitarbeitenden arbeiten von verschiedenen Orten in Europa aus. 🤝 Das Vertrauen von Tausenden Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien zu gewinnen und hervorragende Bewertungen zu erhalten 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1,3 Millionen kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien in Frankreich dabei zu unterstützen, Pennylane zu nutzen Über die Position als Accounting Product Specialist Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Buchhaltungsexpertise und Produktentwicklung. Dabei stellst du die technische Qualität und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben unserer Software für die Buchhaltung sicher. Was bedeutet Erfolg in dieser Rolle? Die drei wichtigsten Verantwortungsbereiche Du berätst das Product-Team , beantwortest Fragen und teilst dein Fachwissen, damit buchhalterische Funktionen korrekt entwickelt werden. Du testest das Produkt und meldest Fehler sowie Feedback an das Product-Team. Du schulst andere Personen im Umgang mit dem Produkt , insbesondere zu buchhalterischen Themen. Dazu gehören externe Zielgruppen, wie die Steuerkanzleien, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten werden, sowie interne Zielgruppen, zum Beispiel neue Mitarbeitende in den Bereichen Product, Sales und Support. Du erstellst dafür geeignete Schulungsunterlagen und organisierst entsprechende Sessions. Dein erwarteter Beitrag in den ersten sechs Monaten Du trägst aktiv zum Produktlaunch bei und stellst sicher, dass die wichtigsten buchhalterischen Funktionen korrekt, gesetzeskonform und effizient umgesetzt sind. Du dokumentierst zentrales Wissen zur französischen und deutschen Buchhaltung sowie zur Funktionsweise des deutschen Produkts. Du schulst die ersten Steuerkanzleien, die Pennylane Deutschland nutzen. Du unterstützt bei der Einstellung und Schulung wichtiger Teammitglieder, insbesondere in den Bereichen Partner Success und Customer Success. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Fachliche Expertise Du unterstützt die Product-Teams bei der Entwicklung und Validierung buchhalterischer und steuerlicher Funktionen, zum Beispiel durch Workshops und die Prüfung von Prototypen. Du hilfst dabei, buchhalterische und steuerliche Anforderungen in klare und verständliche Produktspezifikationen zu übersetzen. Du dokumentierst Produktentscheidungen unter Berücksichtigung buchhalterischer und steuerlicher Vorschriften. Du hinterfragst vorgeschlagene Lösungen aus buchhalterischer und steuerlicher Sicht. Bei Bedarf priorisierst du unterschiedliches Feedback von Nutzer:innen und triffst entsprechende Entscheidungen. Qualitätssicherung Du wirkst bei der Definition buchhaltungsbezogener Testszenarien mit. Du überprüfst die Korrektheit und Konformität von Berechnungen, Buchungssätzen, Abschlüssen, Finanzberichten und Steuererklärungen. Du stellst sicher, dass das erwartete buchhalterische Ergebnis einer Funktion erreicht wird. Wissensmanagement und Schulungen Du erstellst und pflegst technische Dokumentationen zu buchhalterischen und steuerlichen Themen. Du schulst interne Teams zu wichtigen Buchhaltungskonzepten. Du moderierst Sessions zum Wissensaustausch. Dein Profil Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Steuerkanzlei oder im Rechnungswesen. Du bist es gewohnt, mit Mandant:innen und Steuerberater:innen zusammenzuarbeiten, und verfügst über Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen. Fachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über ein fundiertes Verständnis des gesamten Buchhaltungsprozesses und hast Erfahrung mit Abschlussarbeiten, insbesondere mit Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung aus einer Steuerkanzlei oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld mit. Wünschenswert: Du hast ein gutes übergeordnetes Verständnis von Buchhaltung und kennst die Unterschiede zwischen verschiedenen Steuerkanzleien, Tools wie DATEV sowie regionale Besonderheiten. Sprachen: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Du bist neugierig und verfügst über die Fähigkeit, komplexe buchhalterische Themen für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen klar, verständlich und praxisnah zu erklären. Was wir tun, um deinen Arbeitsalltag zu erleichtern 🏢 Diese Position kann vollständig remote von jedem Ort in Deutschland ausgeübt werden. Wenn du in Berlin ansässig bist, kannst du auch unsere Büros in der Rosenthaler Straße 43–45 nutzen. 💵 Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket, über das wir im Screening-Prozess ausführlicher sprechen 📈 Unternehmensanteile, damit du direkt am Erfolg von Pennylane teilhaben kannst 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr 🏡 Ein Budget, mit dem du deinen Arbeitsplatz zu Hause komfortabler gestalten kannst, sowie einen monatlichen Zuschuss für die Arbeit in einem Coworking-Space ⛹️ Über unseren Partner Gymlib erhältst du Zugang zu 8.000 Fitnessstudios und mehr als 300 Wellness- und Freizeitaktivitäten in Europa 🇬🇧 Zugang zu Busuu , um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu verbessern 💻 Die neueste Apple-Ausstattung 🎉 Regelmäßige Firmenevents. Wir legen großen Wert darauf, Zeit miteinander zu verbringen, zum Beispiel bei unseren vierteljährlichen Tech Days, unserem jährlichen Teamevent außerhalb des Büros und Teamtreffen etwa einmal im Monat in unserem Berliner Büro in der Rosenthaler Straße 43–45. 🤝 Unser Bewerbungsprozess Intro-Call: Erstes Gespräch mit Thomas, Recruiter, 30-minütiger Video-Call Manager-Interview: Gespräch mit Cécile Farriaux, Senior Product Manager, 45-minütiger Video-Call Live-Business-Case: Gespräch mit Niklas Weidenkopf, Customer Success Manager für Steuerkanzleien, und Elise, Senior Product Manager, 60 Minuten Abschlussgespräch: Gespräch mit zwei weiteren erfahrenen Ansprechpartner:innen Wir möchten den Prozess schnell und effizient gestalten. Insgesamt dauert unser Bewerbungsprozess in der Regel zwischen 15 und 25 Tagen. Wir haben dir möglichst viele Informationen über den Zweck, die Aufgaben und das Umfeld dieser Position gegeben. Jetzt bist du gefragt: Zeige uns, ob du dich in dieser Position sowohl wohlfühlen als auch einen echten Beitrag zu unserem Unternehmen leisten kannst. Falls du noch unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich trotzdem, dich zu bewerben. title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go), Tenant Scales: Gitaly
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>As a Backend Engineer on the Gitaly team, you’ll help build GitLab’s Git data storage tier, a standalone product that provides reliable, secure, and fast access to Git repositories through application programming interfaces (APIs) and storage operations. You’ll work at the boundary between GitLab and Git to make repository access performant and dependable for <a href="http://gitlab.com">GitLab.com</a>, self-managed customers, and GitLab Dedicated. Our work spans distributed storage, repository management, high availability, performance, observability, and operational excellence. We’re currently building the next generation of source code management (SCM), including new approaches to scaling Git storage and improving how repository data is managed and served.</p> <p>You’ll balance roadmap delivery, technical improvements, customer and reliability work, and operational support. We value pragmatic engineering, thoughtful trade-offs, continuous improvement, and sustainable ways of working while operating a service that’s critical to GitLab. Learn more on the <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure-platforms/tenant-scale/gitaly/">Gitaly Team Page</a>.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own moderately sized to complex technical initiatives from problem definition and proposal through implementation, rollout, monitoring, and operational follow-through.</li> <li>Act as the directly responsible individual for projects by aligning stakeholders, communicating progress and trade-offs, identifying risks, and keeping execution moving with minimal guidance.</li> <li>Lead technical design for distributed storage, Git repository management, performance, reliability, and scalability problems, using data and benchmarking to guide decisions.</li> <li>Partner with engineers and teams across GitLab, including Git, Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering, Dedicated, and customer-facing teams, to deliver cross-functional outcomes.</li> <li>Improve engineering practices through mentoring, documentation, knowledge sharing, design reviews, and constructive code reviews.</li> <li>Take operational ownership of the systems you work on, including incident response, post-incident improvements, capacity and performance analysis, and customer escalations.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve work beyond an individual change through automation, reusable designs, better dashboards, upstream contributions, and improvements to development and testing workflows.</li> <li>Respond to user emergencies, platform alerts, and support requests, including regular on-call duties.</li> <li>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Significant professional experience building, debugging, and optimizing distributed or highly available software systems in large-scale production environments.</li> <li>Experience owning complex projects end to end, including technical design, execution, rollout, and operational support.</li> <li>Strong systems design skills and the ability to reason about performance, failure modes, consistency, concurrency, capacity, and observability.</li> <li>A track record of influencing technical decisions and working effectively with stakeholders across teams and disciplines.</li> <li>Experience mentoring engineers, improving team practices, and raising the quality of designs, code, testing, and documentation.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and make trade-offs clear.</li> <li>Professional experience with Go or another backend or systems language.</li> <li>Experience operating production systems, participating in incident response, and turning operational learnings into durable improvements.</li> <li>Experience with Ruby, Git internals, gRPC, or Git server infrastructure is highly desirable.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Gitaly team includes Backend Engineers who share ownership of the product’s design, implementation, reliability, and customer outcomes. We work autonomously while collaborating closely through design discussions, code reviews, incident response, documentation, and asynchronous communication. Engineers are encouraged to take ownership as directly responsible individuals, seek input early, make decisions transparently, and share knowledge across the team. Learn more on the <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure-platforms/tenant-scale/gitaly/">Gitaly Team Page</a>.</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Staff Security Governance Engineer, you will be the individual contributor who owns how GitLab writes, maintains, communicates, and measures its security policies and standards. You will turn emerging regulations, including AI regulation, into clear requirements that engineering, product, and legal teams can act on, and you will use automation to keep governance lightweight and continuous rather than a point-in-time exercise. You will sit on the Security Governance team within Security Assurance and work closely with Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering. You will report to the Director, Customer Trust & Security Governance.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li><em>Policies and standards</em></li> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end lifecycle of GitLab's security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines: drafting, stakeholder review, approval, publication, annual review, and retirement.</li> <li>Define and run the exception management process, including risk-based approvals, expiry tracking, and trend reporting that shows where policies need to change.</li> <li>Run policy attestation and investigate non-adherence.</li> <li>Keep policies clear, practical, and aligned with how GitLab's engineering teams work in a DevSecOps environment.</li> </ul> <li><em>Regulatory and framework alignment</em></li> <ul> <li>Monitor emerging regulations and standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, sector or regional requirements) and partner with Legal well ahead of compliance deadlines to assess impact and update policy.</li> <li>Maintain mappings between our policies and frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, FedRAMP, and NIST CSF, so requirements are written once and reused.</li> </ul> <li><em>Measurement and assurance</em></li> <ul> <li>Define KPIs for policy adherence and report trends to Security leadership.</li> <li>Run targeted internal assessments of adherence and drive remediation to closure.</li> <li>Support audit activities by coordinating evidence, testing, and remediation management.</li> </ul> <li><em>Customer trust</em></li> <ul> <li>Support customer questionnaires and customer meetings, and help turn recurring customer requests into better policies and self-service content.</li> </ul> <li><em>Automation and AI</em></li> <ul> <li>Identify and implement automation and AI-assisted workflows for policy management, evidence collection, control monitoring, and assessment work, in partnership with GRC Engineering.</li> </ul> <li><em>Technical leadership</em></li> <ul> <li>Act as a technical and program leader across Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering, influencing without direct authority.</li> <li>Mentor other team members and help set the direction of the Security Governance roadmap.</li> </ul> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>10+ years in security governance, GRC, or IT risk, with hands-on ownership of a policy and standards lifecycle and measurable outcomes, ideally at a global technology company.</li> <li>Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, FedRAMP, and NIST CSF, including how to put them into practice, not only how to read them</li> <li>Experience creating and maintaining an enterprise Information Security Management System (ISMS), ideally including hands on involvement in ISO 27001 certification or recertification.<span class="screenreader-hidden-offscreen"> </span></li> <li>Understanding of cloud, SaaS, and DevSecOps practices, and the ability to write policy that engineers will follow.</li> <li>A risk-based mindset that balances compliance with real security risk.</li> <li>Demonstrated use of automation or AI to reduce manual GRC work.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, including translating technical concepts for engineers, executives, auditors, and customers.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering.</li> <li>Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or similar are highly desirable.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What success looks like</strong></h4> <ul> <li>First 30 days: Assessed the current policy library and exception process, built relationships with key stakeholders, and proposed a prioritized roadmap.</li> <li>First 90 days: Uplift the existing security policy library to align with NIST CSF, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, and PCI-DSS.</li> <li>First 120 days: A refreshed review cadence is in place, exception reporting is running, and can demonstrate a measurable improvement in policy adherence.</li> <li>First six months: Develop Policy as Code and collaborate with Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering for implementation into existing workflows.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>The Security Assurance organization helps GitLab build and maintain trust by strengthening how we approach security, compliance, and risk. Security Governance sits within it and owns customer trust, security awareness, policies and standards, and other governance functions. Our counterparts are Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering. <br><br>You will join a small team of four direct reports under the Director, where each person has broad scope and visible impact. We work remote-first and asynchronously, and we write things down and share them openly, so you'll draft and revise policies and standards in the open with input from Security, Legal, Product, and Engineering.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. title: Business Development Director (Europe) - Exeevo Lifesciences CRM
description: About Exeevo Exeevo is a life sciences engagement platform built natively on Microsoft Dynamics 365, helping pharmaceutical, MedTech, and consumer health companies connect more effectively with healthcare professionals and patients. Our products, Exeevo CRM, Exeevo Companion, and Ask-Nova, our embedded AI agent, are trusted by life sciences organisations, from global pharma leaders to fast-growing specialty and mid-market companies. As part of Valsoft Corporation, we combine the agility of a growth-stage company with the stability of a global platform. We are now strengthening our presence across Europe, partnering with pharmaceutical, biotech, and MedTech organisations to modernise how they engage with healthcare professionals and patients across channels and markets. Learn more at www.exeevo.com . The Opportunity We are seeking a sales leader to drive growth across our enterprise and SMB accounts in Europe. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on winning complex, high-value deals with life sciences organisations, while also building a scalable, high-velocity sales motion for small and mid-sized companies. You will own the full sales cycle across enterprise and SMB accounts, from opening executive-level conversations to negotiating multiyear agreements and play a central role in shaping Exeevo’ s growth across Europe. What You'll Do Define and execute the enterprise and SMB sales strategy across Europe, owning the pan-European new-business revenue target and pipeline Tailor the go-to-market approach to the commercial, regulatory, and cultural nuances of priority markets such as DACH, France, the Nordics, Benelux, Southern Europe, and the UK Identify, pursue, and close large, multiyear platform deals with global and regional pharmaceutical, biotech, and MedTech organisations, and build an efficient, repeatable sales motion for small and mid-sized life sciences companies Develop strategic account partner for omnichannel HCP and patient engagement Lead consultative sales cycles, from shorter SMB deals to complex enterprise cycles of 4–8 months, navigating multiple stakeholders across Commercial, Sales Operations, Medical Affairs, IT, Compliance, and Procurement Orchestrate cross-functional deal teams (presales, solution consulting, delivery, legal, and executive sponsors) to title: Team Manager, Financial Crime, Business Banking
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Remote | 💰£32,200 - £40,750 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers">Benefits</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐Our Financial Crime Team</strong></p> <p>Our Financial Crime Business Banking team is the first line of defence in protecting Monzo and our business customers from financial crime activities. </p> <p>You will lead a team of up to 12 senior Investigators, acting as their primary point of contact for technical escalations and professional development. Your goal is to balance high-quality investigative standards with operational efficiency.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Managing the personal & professional development of approximately 12 Senior Financial Crime Business Banking Investigators.</li> <li>Fostering an empathetic, high-performance culture in the team.</li> <li>Providing technical coaching, feedback, and advice relating to financial crime tasks.</li> <li>Analysing and driving improvement in team performance, and reporting relevant insights.</li> <li>Monitoring and maintaining service level adherence on the work completed by the team, reviewing work status and availability of your team members</li> <li>Providing meaningful feedback to your team and learnings are being had from this</li> <li>Communicating and embedding change within the team, driving a positive culture to help us progress as we grow </li> <li>Contributing to a strong control environment by minimising breaches and risk events.</li> <li>Reviewing complaints attributed to the team and identifying opportunities for improvement.</li> <li>Conducting job interviews for financial crime investigators and contributing to hiring decisions.</li> <li>Chairing employee relations cases and making decisions consistent with Monzo’s values.</li> <li>Being part of a high performing management team, supporting each other when required</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have leadership experience within a Financial Crime or Fraud setting, <strong>this is essential.</strong></li> <li>Have an understanding of current financial crime trends and typologies. </li> <li>You have experience providing technical coaching and feedback on FC Business Banking tasks.</li> <li>You're a clear and inspiring communicator, with excellent written and verbal English.</li> <li>You're empathetic and have a supportive approach to people leadership. </li> <li>You're great at prioritising problems and assessing risk in an operations environment.</li> <li>You are passionate about working in a fast paced environment and comfortable with change. </li> </ul> <p><strong>⏰ Hours of work</strong></p> <p>This is a full time, permanent position. You’ll work 37.5hrs a week, Monday - Friday 9am-5:30pm. You’ll also be required to work one weekend a year. </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £32,200 - £40,750 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role is a remote role in the UK </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Application questions </li> <li>Recruiter Call - 30 minute video call to assess role fit & motivation </li> <li>Hiring Manager - 60 minute video call with 2 of our operations managers to assess values and leadership experience</li> </ul> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We don’t have a set closing date for this role, we’ll close applications once we’ve received enough to find the right person. If this sounds like you, please apply as soon as you can.</p> <p>#LI-NG2</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Werkstudent:in Softwareentwicklung Node.js (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind refundrebel, ein aufstrebendes Mobility-Tech-KMU, das an Bahnreisen als die Zukunft unserer nachhaltigen Mobilität glaubt. Durch digitale Technologien wollen wir nachhaltiges Reisen für Unternehmen und Geschäftsreisende attraktiver machen. Wir unterstützen namhafte Unternehmen wie adesso, KfW oder REWE dabei, ihr Bahnreise-Management zu optimieren, Aufwände zu minimieren, Kosten zu senken und Flug- auf Bahnreisen zu verlagern. Dabei arbeiten wir nicht nur, um Geld zu verdienen. Wir arbeiten, weil wir daran glauben, die (Mobilitäts-) Welt ein Stück besser machen zu können. Wir arbeiten, weil wir Spaß am Miteinander haben. Und weil wir an eine neue Arbeitswelt mit dem Menschen im Fokus glauben. Aufgaben Auf unserem modernen Cloud-Stack (AWS, Docker, MongoDB, Express, Node.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Terraform) entwickelst du agil mit. Echter Produktivcode statt Spielwiese: Was du baust, nutzen unsere internen und externen Stakeholder täglich. Dabei arbeitest du nach professionellen Standards und mit modernen Methoden wie KI-gestützter Entwicklung. Du unterstützt uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Systeme: von der Umsetzung neuer Features über die Wartung von bestehendem Code bis hin zur Übernahme eigener Projekte. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt im Backend, Ausflüge ins Frontend sind aber auf jeden Fall möglich. Unser Engineering-Team steht dir zur Seite. Gleichzeitig bringst du eigene Ideen ein und arbeitest selbstständig. Qualifikation Eingeschrieben bist du in (Angewandter) Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Du hast mindestens 10 Stunden wöchentlich Zeit, uns zu unterstützen. Es wäre toll, wenn du dir perspektivisch auch bis zu 20 Stunden vorstellen kannst. Mindestens eine Programmiersprache beherrschst du sicher, und mit Datenbanken hast du schon erste Erfahrungen gesammelt. Lernbereitschaft ist für dich selbstverständlich. Agentic Engineering, Serverless oder moderne Softwarearchitekturen? Da steigst du gern tief ein, auch wenn es anfangs Neuland ist. Mit dem Handwerkszeug der Webentwicklung hast du schon gearbeitet, etwa mit Git, automatisiertem Testing, REST-APIs und Grundlagen der IT-Security. Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastruktur ist ein Plus. Nachhaltigkeit, Mobilität und Digitalisierung liegen dir am Herzen. Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau, Englisch ist von Vorteil. Benefits Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen der gesetzlichen Möglichkeiten. 100 % remote (unsere legendären halbjährliche Teamwochen mal ausgenommen). title: Interim Director of Financial Operations & Control
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. The incumbent Director is stepping out of day-to-day operations to spearhead a strategic, multi-year finance automation and systems program.</p> <p>Your mandate is  to provide steady-state operational leadership across all financial operations, close cycles, and management reporting; and serve as the essential operational contact for the program.  You will ensure BAU integrity while actively operationalising and absorbing newly automated processes.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading all aspects of financial control and operations, including Accounts Payable, Treasury Operations/Product Control, Money Operations ensuring robust, well controlled, and timely transaction processing.</li> <li>Leading the production and end-to-end delivery of monthly close and management reporting cycle, working across Finance to provide the Group Financial Controller, UK CFO and EU CFOs with actionable insights and variance analysis.</li> <li>Maintaining a robust, control and governance framework focused on integrity of our data and processes.  </li> <li>Serving as the primary operational counterpart and sounding board to the Director of Financial Operations & Control (incumbent) within the programme, providing operational feedback on target operating models and workflow designs.</li> <li>Managing team capacity and workflows to free up key subject matter experts for involvement in the programme, including (not limited to) User Acceptance Testing, parallel runs, and systems testing.</li> <li>Supporting the practical change management and operational rollout of new automation tools within the live environment, establishing new standard operating procedures without interrupting daily processing.</li> <li>Working closely with the Director of Financial & Regulatory Reporting to ensure core financial operations and control processes comply with overarching accounting policies  and provide a seamless hand off into the consolidation.</li> <li>Providing stable, empathetic, and accountable leadership to a distributed team during a period of change, maintaining high engagement, retention, and performance.</li> <li>Building and maintaining effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, external auditors and advisors.</li> <li>Driving the delivery of the Financial Operations and Control teams milestones and actions on existing key projects such as EU expansion, working with stakeholders to identify and resolve delivery risks.</li> <li>Managing a structured, documented operational handover back to permanent leadership at the conclusion of the 12-month term.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Role Scope Clarification</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Included:</strong> Global financial operations and control process ownership, including delivery of those services to subsidiaries, Treasury operations/Product control, Money Operations, Month-end Close and related management reporting.</li> <li><strong>Excluded:</strong> Group Consolidation and the preparation/filing of Statutory Financial Statements for the Group and subsidiaries; Regulatory Reporting. </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a demonstrated track record stepping into high volume, multi-entity finance operations leadership roles and delivering immediate stability within regulated environments (Fintech, Banking, or Financial Services preferred). </li> <li>You’re an empathetic, effective people leader with a strong track record of coaching individuals and fostering a positive, high-performing environment.</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of internal control environments and the ability to build "best-in-class" processes.</li> <li>You have experience operating within complex, multi-entity or cross-border structures where data consistency is paramount.</li> <li>You have demonstrated experience operationalising new technology, and embedding change within Finance teams.</li> <li>Have excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain operational complexities to key stakeholders and peers.</li> <li>You are adaptability and resilience in fast-paced, tech-led, and agile environments.</li> <li>You hold strong technical accounting knowledge (IFRS) </li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £142,000 - £170,000.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) <strong>*(delete if doesn’t apply) </strong></p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 5 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Initial Call with the Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager Interview</li> <li>Role Specific Interview</li> <li>Behavioural Interview</li> <li>Final Interview with the Team </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.</p> <p> #LI-TP1 #LI-REMOTE<strong><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Renewals Manager - Italy/ Spain
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. The Associate Renewals Manager works under the general direction of Senior Renewals Managers and their manager, following specific instructions and frameworks in day-to-day work. unmet needs within existing accounts, connecting what customers describe to relevant GitLab capabilities they aren't yet using.</li> <li>Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related customers and internal stakeholders, adapting to GitLab's communication framework.</li> <li>Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM/renewals system for forecasting and reporting.</li> remote work best practices.</li> <li>Growth mindset and sense of ownership — proactively seeks out ways to learn and improve, and takes action rather than waiting for direction.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing many renewals at once.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to follow defined processes and title: Werkstudent / Intern (m/w/d) Social Media & Content Creator
description: Über Beglaubigt.de Du kennst jeden TikTok-Trend, bevor er viral geht? Du schneidest Reels im Schlaf, ob in CapCut oder mit KI-Tools, und hast Lust, selbst vor der Kamera zu stehen? title: Senior Account Executive Public Sector (m/w/d)

title: Senior Manager, Supplier Performance, FinCrime, Fraud & Disputes
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our FinCrime, Fraud & Disputes teams⭐</strong></p> <p>We are recruiting a Senior Manager to join our FinCrime, Fraud and Disputes team, whilst supporting our Supplier Performance function. Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service.</p> <p>We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area. </p> <p>Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.</p> <p><strong><br>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a dedicated oversight team:</strong> You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.</li> <li><strong>Managing the partnership day to day:</strong> You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.</li> <li><strong>Acting as the translation layer:</strong> You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.</li> <li><strong>Tracking and managing performance:</strong> You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.</li> <li><strong>Forecasting and planning:</strong> Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.</li> <li><strong>Owning change execution:</strong> You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.</li> <li><strong>Integrating the teams:</strong> You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.</li> <li>You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of leading through others and  can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.</li> <li>You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.</li> <li>You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></em></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call (25 minutes)</li> <li>Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)</li> <li>Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br></p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a><br><br></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.<strong><em><br><br></em></strong></p> <p>#LI-REMOTE<strong> </strong>#LI-CB4</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Capital Markets Manager (m/f/d)
description: 𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘆 At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren’t built for. NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so our clients can launch and run ETFs at scale, helping broaden the access to the market beyond a small group of dominant, US-based providers. If you're a privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, has an interest in technology and takes a practical approach to solving legal challenges, we'd be interested in hearing from you. title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description: At Luscii, we're creating space for care by developing and improving digital healthcare applications that make a real difference in people's lives through several applications. From Luscii Thuismeten, which helps healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, to OMRON Connect, connecting millions of people with their health data through OMRON devices, and other applications that expand the possibilities of digital healthcare. Together with healthcare professionals and partners around the world, we're working towards a future where people receive the right care in the right place. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll help shape and modernise the cloud infrastructure behind these applications, building a reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide. Our applications have different histories, architectures and technical challenges. OMRON Connect, for example, runs on an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Parts of its infrastructure still carry legacy, including manual processes, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make changes slower and riskier than they should be. We're working towards a more consistent engineering foundation across our applications. Think Infrastructure as Code, cloud-native and event-driven architecture where it adds value, safe continuous deployment and observability by default. We're bringing more senior engineering expertise in-house to turn that ambition into concrete technical decisions, shared standards and a roadmap our teams can own. And that's where you come in 😉 Your role You will work across our engineering teams, helping shape the cloud infrastructure behind our digital healthcare applications. Your focus will be on making the right architectural decisions, modernising existing platforms and enabling teams to independently build, maintain and improve their systems. This isn't a greenfield architecture exercise. You will be improving live healthcare platforms while balancing technical improvements with product delivery, security, regulatory requirements and the realities of working with stakeholders across different countries, including the Netherlands and Japan. What you will be doing, among others: Own and evolve the Cloud & Backend roadmap, translating the engineering vision into clear priorities, trade-offs and next steps. Drive cross-team architecture decisions to a close, making sure decisions are transparent, documented and followed through. Establish shared technical standards and guardrails that allow teams to work autonomously without creating unnecessary dependencies. Work hands-on with engineers on AWS and Terraform, reviewing designs and pull requests and challenging technical choices where needed. Coach and pair with engineers, helping knowledge spread across teams and supporting the growth of seniority and ownership. Work with product owners, QA, engineering leadership and colleagues in Japan to balance technical direction with product, regulatory, security and cost considerations. Help move the platform towards automated infrastructure, safer deployments and stronger observability without relying on a big-bang rewrite. The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH ; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better. Most important benefits Salary : An annual maximum remuneration of approximately € 85.000 gross per year is estimated for this position (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii), depending on the interviews, your experience, background and knowledge. Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. We do work from Mondays to Thursdays, as 32 hours per week is fulltime. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least 5+ years of experience in cloud/backend engineering and multiple years of hands-on experience with AWS and Terraform (Infrastructure as Code). You are comfortable reviewing designs and pull requests. Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures is very valuable. All combined with experience in serverless AWS, Node.js/TypeScript tech stacks. You actively coach, pair, review and share knowledge, with a focus on building ownership and seniority across the teams around you. You understand what matters: the importance of making pragmatic technical choices within clear security, compliance and regulatory boundaries. You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
description: <p><strong>About Sezzle:</strong></p> <p>With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong>:</p> <p>For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is <strong> $12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level </strong>per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience</p> <p><strong>About the Role: </strong></p> <p class="p1">We are seeking an exceptional <strong>Principal Infrastructure Engineer</strong> to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.</p> <p class="p1">You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.</p> <p class="p1">Our stack runs on <strong>AWS</strong>, with workloads orchestrated on <strong>Kubernetes</strong> and data anchored in <strong>Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres)</strong>. You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.</p> <p class="p1">Operational ownership is part of the job. You will <strong>participate in the on-call rotation</strong> and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.</p> <p class="p1">You will also build and apply <strong>AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling</strong> for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.</p> <p class="p1">This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll do: </strong></p> <ul> <li class="li1"><strong>Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure</strong>: identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Connect business understanding to improvements across the system</strong>: learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Engineer for scale and performance</strong>: build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Design and build AWS infrastructure</strong>: implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build and operate the Kubernetes platform</strong>: improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres</strong>: tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Improve reliability through engineering</strong>: define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents</strong>: use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Implement and test disaster recovery</strong>: design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation</strong>: make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build observability that makes production diagnosable</strong>: improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deliver safe infrastructure migrations</strong>: design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes</strong>: right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling</strong>: apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.</li> <li class="li2"><strong>Make technical decisions clear and executable</strong>: write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting implementing and testing <strong>disaster recovery</strong> against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.</li> <li class="li1">Practical experience
