title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse. You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant. - Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production. - Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping. - Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation. - Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works. - Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions. - Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice. - Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it. - Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts. - Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting. - Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE: - Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience. - Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility. - Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype. - Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers. - Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost. - Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences. - Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions. - Know Postgres and relational database practice. - Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams. - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector. - Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped. - Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents. - Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates. - Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained. - Experience across several product surfaces or teams. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Senior Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer (76080)

Dabei bist du nicht einfach Anforderungsmanager, sondern Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden und unsere interdisziplinären Teams. Folgende Aufgaben warten: Analyse und Strukturierung komplexer fachlicher Problemstellungen, Geschäftsprozesse und Anforderungen mit Fokus auf das eigentliche Problem hinter der Anfrage; Planung und Moderation von Interviews, Workshops und Reviews; Erhebung, Strukturierung, Priorisierung und Validierung von Anforderungen sowie Erarbeitung geeigneter Fachkonzepte, Modelle und Spezifikationen; Erarbeitung präziser, prüfbarer Spezifikationen und Kontrakte als verlässliche «Single Source of Truth» für Entwicklung und Testing; Analyse von Schnittstellen, Datenflüssen, Rollen und Systemgrenzen; Abstimmung zwischen Fachbereichen, UX, Architektur, Entwicklung, Test und Betrieb; Begleitung von Anforderungen von der ersten Idee bis zu fachlichen Tests und Abnahmen und Aktive Weiterentwicklung unserer Methoden und Kompetenzen in Business Analysis und Requirements Engineering Mehrjährige fundierte Erfahrung als Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle in komplexen IT-Vorhaben Erfahrung mit modernen Spezifikations- und Modellierungsansätzen (z. B. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>As a Technical Recruiter, you'll help GitLab build the engineering and product teams behind our DevSecOps platform. In this individual contributor role, you'll partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Security, and UX and own searches from intake through close. You'll build inclusive pipelines and use data and market insight to guide hiring decisions, while growing into a trusted talent advisor.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage full-cycle searches for roles such as Backend and Frontend Engineers, Site Reliability Engineers, Security Engineers, Data Engineers, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers, delivering against agreed recruiting goals and key metrics with accurate, timely documentation in Greenhouse.</li> <li>Lead intake and kickoff conversations to align hiring teams on role scope, technical requirements, team context, interview plans, and timelines, with senior team guidance as needed.</li> <li>Partner with hiring teams on structured, equitable technical interviews with clear competencies and actionable feedback; challenge assumptions and escalate risks or blockers early.</li> <li>Use talent-market research, compensation benchmarks, funnel metrics, and candidate feedback to shape search strategy and address hiring issues.</li> <li>Assess technical candidates on depth of experience, scope and impact of past work, problem-solving, and open source or community contributions, and how well their skills fit GitLab's teams and technology.</li> <li>Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing plans that balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, and targeted outreach across technical communities and specialized talent pools.</li> <li>Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation, equity, and benefits.</li> <li>Improve recruiting practices by sharing learnings and reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Intermediate-level recruiting experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle searches independently.</li> <li>Technical recruiting experience, or a strong interest in learning engineering and product disciplines, tech stacks, team structures, and how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Developing advisor skills: building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations.</li> <li>Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines for hard-to-fill or specialized roles.</li> <li>A data-informed approach that turns funnel insights into practical actions.</li> <li>Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care.</li> <li>Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, or comparable platforms; ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.</li> <li>Experience recruiting for DevSecOps, developer tools, or open source software is helpful, not required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>We work in a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. title: Head of Ecosystem
description: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We aim to empower developers by providing a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're looking for a Head of Ecosystem to lead the teams that make Supabase the backend for the platforms and tools developers already use. That covers AI app builders and coding agents, integrations with the developer tools teams rely on, and the Supabase Marketplace. You'll build this org from the ground up and shape how Supabase extends beyond its own platform. You'll also drive hiring, onboarding, and career development while maintaining high engineering standards. WHAT YOU'LL OWN: - Build and lead a new engineering org across platform partners, integrations, and Marketplace, hiring EMs and engineers as it grows - Own the technical relationship with the platforms building on Supabase, from integration health to escalations - Set and maintain clear roadmaps that balance partner needs with platform priorities - Partner with Product, Partnerships, and Sales to define and execute our ecosystem strategy - Ship a unified, self-serve surface for integrations and Marketplace - Maintain high engineering standards: roadmap hygiene, issue tracking, on-call, incident response, and responsiveness to partners WHAT YOU BRING: - Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams, including managing other managers - Experience building and running platform, API, or integration surfaces that third parties depend on in production - Technical credibility with partner engineering teams, and the judgment to say no - Experience building teams or an org from a small base, including hiring and developing engineering managers - Strong organizational and execution skills: setting roadmaps, driving accountability, and keeping teams moving under uncertainty - Experience managing remote, globally distributed teams - Excellent cross-functional communication skills, especially with Product and commercial teams - Collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable Bonus points if you: - Have experience with OAuth, platform APIs, or app marketplaces - Have worked on a developer platform's partner or app ecosystem - Have worked with AI app builders or coding agents WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Backend Engineer (Python),AI Engineering: Agent Foundations
location: Remote, Canada; Remote, Poland; Remote, United Kingdom
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer (Python) in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers the reusable building blocks agents and flows are made from as well as our core harness, Duo Developer.</p> <p>Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway. You'll also work across the stack where needed. You'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the Duo Workflow Service, the AI Gateway and, where needed, the GitLab monolith. Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.</li> <li>Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry.</li> <li>Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.</li> <li>Design, implement and review APIs (including GraphQL and REST) and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients such as the GitLab monolith, IDE extensions and Duo CLI.</li> <li>Improve and extend automated testing (pytest and other frameworks), including evaluations of agent and flow behavior, to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.</li> <li>Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.</li> <li>Join Tier 2 <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure-platforms/incident-management/on-call/tier-2/">on-call rotations</a> to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.</li> <li>Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class as more work becomes agentic.</li> <li>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models.</li> <li>Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses.</li> <li>Skill in designing or extending APIs (REST, GraphQL or gRPC) with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.</li> <li>Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and/or JavaScript and Vue is a plus.</li> <li>Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.</li> <li>Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/ai/agent-foundations/">Agent Foundations stage</a> builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution. Between them, they own the GitLab Duo Developer foundational flow and the Flow Registry; the AI Catalog, including custom agents, custom flows and external agent integrations; and agent execution, agent tools and agent observability.</p> <p>Our engineers work async-first across EMEA, AMER, and India timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Unsere eidgenössisch anerkannten Psychotherapeut:innen arbeiten eng mit dem Behandlungsteam zusammen, damit emotionale Belastung und Essverhalten gemeinsam angegangen werden. Bei Oviva prägen flache Hierarchien, Gestaltungsspielraum und grosse Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeit unsere Zusammenarbeit. Die Stelle Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen. Deine Aufgaben Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch. Du arbeitest eng und interdisziplinär in einem multiprofessionellen Team (u.a. mit Ärztinnen) zusammen, um eine umfassende Betreuung zu gewährleisten. Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne, digitale Psychotherapie bei Oviva aussieht. Du bringst Deine Expertise als Psychotherapeut:in ein, um Versorgung neu zu denken und echte Wirkung zu erzielen. Dein Profil Eidg. anerkannte Psychotherapeut/in Abgeschlossenes klinisches Jahr in einer Institution der SIWF Kategorie A, B oder C Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit Deine fundierte psychotherapeutische Kernkompetenz ist genau das, was wir suchen – ein zusätzliches, spezifisches Vorwissen im Bereich Ernährung oder Gewicht wird nicht vorausgesetzt. Was Dich bei Oviva erwartet Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die moderne Gesundheitsversorgung revolutioniert und ganzheitliche Therapieansätze fördert. title: Product Manager - Postgres
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Product Manager to own Postgres itself at Supabase. Every Supabase project is a full Postgres database, and Postgres is the foundation that Auth, Storage, Realtime and Edge Functions run on. You'll own the product experience of the database: Postgres versions and upgrades, maintenance, observability, extensions and security. You'll work closely with our Postgres engineering teams and with the PM lead for Databases, who leads Multigres https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PxlZssDNrws. You'll define the Postgres requirements that architecture must meet, and own how customers experience their database through that transition. This role is ideal for someone who loves Postgres, sweats the details that make a database trustworthy, and is excited about improving the experience for millions of developers. Small improvements here compound across every project on the platform. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - You'll own Postgres versions, upgrades and end-of-life. Which major and minor versions we support, how and when customers upgrade, and how we retire old versions. Your goal is to make upgrades routine rather than risky. - You'll make maintenance predictable. You'll design how we schedule, communicate and run maintenance windows so customers stay informed and in control, and disruption is rare and expected. - You'll help developers understand their database. Query performance, metrics, logs and advisors: you'll own the path from "my database is slow" to the fix. - You'll own our extension ecosystem. Which extensions we offer, how we evaluate and support new ones, and how we keep them working across versions. - You'll own Postgres security. Roles and permissions, Row Level Security ergonomics, secure defaults, and how we respond to Postgres and extension CVEs. - You'll talk to developers across the full spectrum, from indie developers on their first project to enterprises running critical workloads, and bring what you learn into every prioritization call. - You'll own the problem definition, requirements and success metrics for what we ship, such as upgrade success rate, the share of the fleet on supported versions, and time-to-diagnose for performance problems. You'll set the metric before the team builds, then track it after launch. - You'll keep Engineering, Support and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order, and communicate version changes and deprecations clearly to customers. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE - 4+ years of Product Management experience on databases, developer tools or infrastructure, or equivalent depth as an engineer, DBA or founder moving into product. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required. - Know Postgres well, or another relational database well enough to ramp quickly. You're comfortable reading EXPLAIN output and talking about replication, WAL, roles and extensions. - Have shipped products where reliability and trust are the experience. You treat downtime and breaking changes as product problems, not just operational ones. - Write clearly. Your specs, announcements and deprecation notices leave little room for confusion. - Build with what you own. You run queries, test upgrades and try extensions yourself, and form opinions through first-hand use. - Use AI to move faster. You use AI tools to compress research, drafting and feedback synthesis so you spend more time on judgment calls. - Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings. STRONG SIGNAL - Worked on a managed database service. - Ran Postgres in production: upgrades, tuning, incident response. - Worked on database observability, performance tooling, or security and compliance products. - Contributed to Postgres, its extensions, or the wider open-source community. - Shipped something using Supabase. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Your contributions and collaboration with your fellow team members will ensure that GitLab CI/CD remains a best in class solution.</p> <p>Some of the things we have recently been working on include:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-org/-/epics/16321">Inputs for Pipelines</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-org/-/epics/17833">Inputs for Jobs</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-org/-/epics/10603">Inputs Enhancements</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-org/-/epics/15241">CI/CD Catalog - UX improvements</a></li> <li>Learn more on the Pipeline Authoring direction pages:</li> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/direction/verify/pipeline_composition/">Pipeline Composition</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/direction/verify/component_catalog/">Component Catalog</a> </li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Pipeline Authoring team is made up of experienced Engineers, some having worked in this area for many years and some having joined more recently. The team shares a passion for finding solutions to complex challenges that scale and are maintainable. Located across five countries and several time zones, async communication is key to our success. The team lives by <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/values/">GitLab’s core values</a> and is always eager to improve. Many things in GitLab begin with a pipeline, so our team regularly interacts with other GitLab teams, community contributors and customers as we strive to create the best possible Pipeline Authoring experience.</p> <p>Learn more on the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/ops/verify/pipeline-authoring/">Pipeline Authoring group handbook page</a> and <a href="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL05JrBw4t0Kol1jCvpk_hqGJrbZ7DnihP">Pipeline Authoring Unfiltered playlist</a>.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Write high-quality, efficient, and maintainable code while adhering to best practices and contributing to code reviews.</li> <li>Ship small features and improvements with minimal guidance and support from other team members. Collaborate with the team on larger projects.</li> <li>Advocate for improvements to reliability, security, and performance.</li> <li>Recognize impediments to our efficiency as a team (“technical debt”), propose and implement solutions.</li> <li>Participate in agile development practices, including async planning sessions, stand-ups, and retrospectives, to drive iterative software development and continuous improvement for the team.</li> <li>Contribute to our development process by asking questions and providing feedback to make us better as a team.</li> <li>Embrace continuous learning and stay connected with industry best practices, tools, and technologies to drive improvements in our software.</li> <li>Participate in <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure/incident-management/tier2-oncall/">Tier 2 on-call</a> rotations to assist troubleshooting product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proficiency with Ruby and Ruby on Rails </li> <li>Proven experience writing testable code in Ruby on Rails</li> <li>Experience with Relational Database Management Systems (PostgreSQL is a plus)</li> <li>Experience with GraphQL is a plus</li> <li>An ability to self manage and organize in an asynchronous and collaborative work environment</li> <li>Demonstrated capacity to clearly and concisely communicate about complex technical, architectural, and/or organizational problems and propose thorough iterative solutions</li> <li>Familiarity with various stages of software development end-to-end (Agile methodologies is a plus)</li> <li>Proven ability to work effectively in a team including product managers, designers, and other engineers</li> <li>A commitment to continuous learning and openness to giving and receiving feedback as a part of fostering individual and team development</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. architecture in production and using modular approaches such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, or event-driven boundaries.</li> <li value="4">Experience building alignment through clear written proposals and decision records so teams document, understand, and adopt technical decisions.</li> <li value="5">Experience making code review, documentation, and practice.</li> <li value="7">Production experience with artificial intelligence-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including improving how a team adopts title: Senior Manager, Supplier Performance, Customer Ops & Specialist Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Customer Operations & Specialist Services teams⭐</strong></p> <p>We are recruiting for 4 opportunities across our Customer Operations and Specialist Services teams to join us as Senior Manager in Supplier Performance. <strong>We are recruiting for 4 roles, with 1 to join us in each of the following areas: Complaints, VAIB (Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusivity and Bereavements), Financial Health and Core Customer Operations. <br><br></strong>Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service.</p> <p>We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area. </p> <p>Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.</p> <p><strong><br>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a dedicated oversight team:</strong> You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.</li> <li><strong>Managing the partnership day to day:</strong> You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.</li> <li><strong>Acting as the translation layer:</strong> You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.</li> <li><strong>Tracking and managing performance:</strong> You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.</li> <li><strong>Forecasting and planning:</strong> Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.</li> <li><strong>Owning change execution:</strong> You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.</li> <li><strong>Integrating the teams:</strong> You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.</li> <li>You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of leading through others and  can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.</li> <li>You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.</li> <li>You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></em></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call (25 minutes)</li> <li>Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)</li> <li>Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br></p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a><br><br></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.<strong><em><br><br></em></strong></p> <p>#LI-REMOTE<strong> </strong>#LI-CB4</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

GitLab installations and reference architecture deployments using tools like Terraform and Ansible across major cloud providers..<br>• Contributing to migrations to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, and sharing customer feedback with GitLab’s Product and Engineering teams..</p> <p><br>What you’ll do</p> <p>• Deliver assigned GitLab Professional Services work, including installation, migration, training, and advisory services across GitLab capabilities..<br>• Configure and support deployments ranging from single-node Omnibus installations to established reference architectures using IaC and CaC practices..<br>• Contribute to migration plans and carry out assigned activities to move customers from other systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab..<br>• Work with Engagement Managers and Project Managers to understand customer goals, scope, and delivery expectations..<br>• Provide practical technical guidance within your area of experience, and ask for support on complex design decisions..<br>• Communicate progress, blockers, and next steps to customers and project stakeholders..<br>• Work with GitLab’s Product and Engineering teams to help resolve customer issues and share relevant feedback..<br>• Contribute ideas that help improve delivery consistency and reduce friction..<br>• Create clear implementation notes, handoff materials, and other engagement documentation..</p> <p><br>What you’ll bring</p> <p>• Professional exposure to one or more IaC or CaC technologies, such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, Chef, or Kubernetes..<br>• Experience with at least one major cloud provider, such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure..<br>• Experience using, deploying, or configuring GitLab, including a solid understanding of Git and source control workflows..<br>• Familiarity with security and AI technologies, or the ability to build knowledge in these areas..<br>• Experience contributing to customer-facing technical work, such as installation, migration, training, or advisory services..<br>• Clear written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to provide status updates and work effectively in a remote, largely asynchronous environment..<br>• A solution-oriented approach to investigating issues, explaining options, and following through on agreed actions..<br>• Strong organization and collaboration skills, including the ability to manage assigned work across customer engagements..<br>• Ability to work effectively in a fully remote organization, document decisions, collaborate across time zones, and work in ways consistent with GitLab’s values..</p> <p>#LI-CM1</p> <p><br>About the team</p> <p><br>Professional Services partners closely with Engagement Managers and Project Managers to deliver consistent customer outcomes. title: Business Development Representative, Financial Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. You'll be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.</p> <p>Our BDRs come from a diverse background. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Previous tech industry experience in an outbound sales development role is required.</li> <li>Experience selling into or supporting the Financial Services (FINS) industry is preferred.</li> <li>Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.</li> <li>Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.</li> <li>Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.</li> <li>Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.</li> <li>Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.</li> <li>Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.</li> <li><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li> <li>Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. title: Software Engineer, Web Infrastructure
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Web Infrastructure builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients so product engineers can ship fast, reliable, accessible experiences. As a junior engineer on the team, you’ll help make those experiences measurably faster and more resilient. You’ll investigate performance bottlenecks, improve how the client loads and responds, and help build tools that catch regressions earlier. You don’t need to arrive as a performance expert; we’re looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, and a desire to learn by shipping useful work. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Use browser tools and real-world data to investigate page-load and interaction bottlenecks, then turn findings into focused improvements. - Help build or improve performance tests, dashboards, and guardrails that make regressions easier to catch during development and rollout. - Ship scoped improvements to client loading, rendering, asset delivery, or caching, measuring their impact and checking for regressions. - Partner with Web Infrastructure and product engineers to land changes safely across Notion’s web clients. - Document what you learn and share clear recommendations so teams can make better performance tradeoffs. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Solid programming fundamentals and some experience building software with JavaScript or TypeScript; familiarity with React or another component-based UI framework is helpful. - Curiosity about how browsers work and how code affects page load, rendering, and interaction responsiveness. - A thoughtful debugging approach: you can break a problem down, gather evidence, and ask for help when you’re stuck. - Clear, kind communication and an interest in collaborating across teams. - Intellectual curiosity about AI-enabled engineering tools; you use them thoughtfully and review their output critically. Experience with performance profiling, browser developer tools, React profiling, bundlers, code splitting, service workers, asset caching, or performance testing is a plus—not a prerequisite. We welcome candidates who are excited about the work even if they don’t match every bullet. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Senior Contracts Manager
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Contracts Manager to take ownership of vendor contracting at Supabase. You will be the go-to contracts partner for everything we buy. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with real ownership, for an experienced negotiator who takes pride in making procurement faster while managing risk. You will negotiate directly, build the playbooks and workflows that let the business self-serve on low-risk deals, and escalate the right issues to Legal at the right time. We work AI-first in Legal: you will use Claude and Ironclad every day to move faster and with greater accuracy. Your work will shape how procurement and vendor contracting scale as Supabase grows. WHAT YOU WILL DO Own vendor contracting end to end - Review, draft, and negotiate a high volume of vendor agreements, including MSAs, order forms, SOWs, SaaS and cloud subscription terms, DPAs, and NDAs. - Serve as the single point of contact for all vendor contracting matters raised by FinOps, IT, Security, and business owners, from intake through signature, renewals, amendments, disputes, and offboarding. As capacity allows, you will also support the broader Commercial Legal team on other matters. - Apply and further build out our playbook and risk framework independently, and escalate to the Assistant General Counsel, Commercial where a deal falls outside approved positions or raises novel legal risk. - Negotiate data, privacy, and security terms (DPAs, security exhibits, cross-border transfers) within the Security team’s playbook, and bring in the AGC, Commercial or Privacy for anything outside it. - Review AI vendor terms, such as training on our data, output ownership, and model changes. Build and scale vendor contracting operations - Build out and maintain our vendor playbook in Claude, so the whole team works from the same guidance and low-risk deals move without bottlenecks. - Design and improve intake, triage, and approval workflows with FinOps. - Own the vendor and procurement workflow in Ironclad, including intake, templates, approvals, and the repository, working with Legal Ops, who own the platform. Use it to track renewals and notice windows with FinOps and flag spend concentration risks. - Create training and self-serve resources for business partners, and raise the visibility of the contracts function as a business enabler. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Required - 6 to 8+ years of experience negotiating procurement, vendor, or technology transactions contracting, ideally buy-side at a U.S. SaaS or technology company, with deep knowledge of SaaS, cloud, and software licensing terms. - A track record of negotiating directly with vendors and their counsel, independently and at pace. - Strong working knowledge of privacy, data protection, and security terms in commercial contracts, including DPA negotiation and international data transfers. - Experience designing contracting processes that are consistent, transparent, and easy for the business to follow. - Clear writing and speaking, with the ability to explain legal and commercial risk plainly and the judgment to know when to hold a position, approve a reasonable risk, or escalate. - Comfort using AI tools, Claude in particular, with sound judgment about when to rely on outputs, how to verify them, and how to protect confidential information. Preferred - A degree in a relevant field (for example, law, economics, or political science), though we value experience over the specific degree. - Sell-side experience negotiating customer, partner, or reseller agreements for a SaaS or technology company, which helps you see vendor terms from the other side. - Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a similar CLM tool (Juro, Docusign CLM) or building AI-assisted legal workflows, ideally with some exposure to AI governance. - Experience working across jurisdictions or with distributed, international teams. - Experience at a fast-growing, developer-focused, cloud, security, or open source company. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Revenue Cycle Manager
description: About Us We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health. Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today. By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth. We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company. Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B. We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where" . Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare. Role overview Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution. What Youâll Do Manage and support RCM specialists working across home health revenue cycle workflows. Track attendance and monitor individual and team performance against established KPIs and daily quotas. Review workflow boards throughout the day to spot backlogs, red flags, and specialists at risk of missing their end-of-day quotas. Respond promptly to specialist questions while balancing real-time workflow monitoring and other team needs. Identify process gaps and work with the team to resolve issues affecting daily performance. Apply your home health and Homecare Homebase (HCHB) knowledge to help specialists navigate workflows and resolve operational questions. Accounts receivable and collections Guide specialists and team leads in prioritizing assigned commercial, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage receivables, including aged balances, payer responses, rejections, denials, and upcoming filing or appeal deadlines. Oversee claim follow-up through resolution: verify claim status and payment, investigate collection barriers and underpayments, and guide appropriate corrections, reprocessing, reconsiderations, or appeals under payer-specific requirements. Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution. Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process. Quality and team development Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance. Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues. Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows. Basic Qualifications Strong experience in home health revenue cycle operations. Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB). Experience managing RCM specialists, including tracking attendance and performance KPIs. Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets. Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve. Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements. Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams. Ability to respond promptly to team questions while managing multiple priorities. Ability to identify workflow or process gaps and help the team address them. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing distributed or offshore revenue cycle teams. Familiarity with commercial fee-for-service and Medicare or Medicare Advantage home health claims, including episodic/PDGM workflows. Experience with AR dashboards, clearinghouses, and payer portals such as Waystar and Availity. Experience using denial trends, quality reviews, or operational data to improve collections workflows and team training. title: Senior Product Manager
description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job. Key responsibilities Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list. Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them. Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs. Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses. Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path. Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended. Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client. Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse. Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards. Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need. Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework. Your background You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through: A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there. Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with. Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working. A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role. A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant. Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus. You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦ Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires; Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows; Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them. Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive. Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability. KPIs & Success Measures We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output: Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%. Workflow adoption (lead): percentage of monthly active users who run a workflow. Target [TBD]%. Workflow run growth: month-on-month percentage growth in workflow runs. Target [TBD]%. First workflow conversion: percentage of new users who complete a successful run within their first [TBD] days. Share of generations through workflows: percentage of all generations produced by workflow runs. Agent and human collaboration: percentage of workflow runs built or started by Scribble. Connector adoption: percentage of active workspaces that use at least one third-party connection in a workflow each month. Target [TBD]%. Integration usage: percentage of workflow runs that start from, or deliver to, a third-party connection. Target [TBD]%. Reliability (hygiene bar): percentage of runs that complete without manual intervention, held at or above [TBD]%. Learning velocity (supporting): percentage of launches reviewed after release against their stated hypothesis. Target 100%. Benefits 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme Health insurance / private medical cover Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development Remote - work from anywhere in your home country Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for our UK employees Flexible working hours Deep Dive About Pencil Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI. We're called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past. Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500. https://www.trypencil.com About The Brandtech Group The Brandtech Group's mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology. It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022. Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco ItaÃº, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever. In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of PokÃ©mon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund). The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI.
