description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">📍London or UK Remote | 💰 <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">Engineer III</a> <br><br>Compensation: £85,000 - £110,000 +<strong> </strong>Incentive Awards tied to your performance + </span><a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Benefits</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> | </span><a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Technology</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></p> <p><strong>About our Engineering Teams:</strong></p> <p>We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.</p> <p>These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻</strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️</p> <p>Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.</p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</li> <li>you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</li> <li>you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</li> <li>you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</li> </ul> <p>We're on the look out for L40 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">Engineering Progression Framework</a> you will be interviewed across the whole framework, so if you're not sure what level you're aiming for chat to your recruiter! </p> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on: </strong></p> <p>We hire very technically agnostic so <strong>whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge</strong>, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: </p> <ul> <li><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a> to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial <a href="https://tour.golang.org/welcome/1"><strong>here</strong></a>)</li> <li><a href="http://cassandra.apache.org/"><strong>Cassandra</strong></a> for most persistent data storage</li> <li><a href="http://kafka.apache.org/"><strong>Kafka</strong></a> for our asynchronous message queue</li> <li><a href="http://kubernetes.io/"><strong>Kubernetes</strong></a> and <a href="https://www.docker.com/"><strong>Docker</strong></a> to schedule and run our services </li> <li><a href="https://www.envoyproxy.io/"><strong>Envoy Proxy</strong></a> for RPC</li> <li><a href="http://aws.amazon.com/"><strong>AWS</strong></a> for most of our production infrastructure and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/"> <strong>GCP</strong></a> for most of our data infrastructure</li> <li>React for our public web apps and internal tools</li> <li>We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages: </p> <ol> <li>Initial Call </li> <li>Take home task or pair coding exercise </li> <li>Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview </li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p>One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/23/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process"><strong>here</strong></a>.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 <span style="font-weight: 400;">£85,000 - £110,000</span> base salary <span style="font-weight: 400;">+<strong> </strong>Incentive Awards tied to your performance</span></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here </strong></a></p> <p><em>We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so there's no closing date for this job.</em></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p>#LI-ZM1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion title: Controls Product Senior Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£85,000 - £115,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p>This role sits at the heart of our Control Discipline change agenda, building the controls product platform that powers safe growth at Monzo.</p> <p>At Monzo, we don’t treat risk and controls as a bureaucratic governance process. We treat our control framework, tools, and data pipelines as an internal <em>product</em> - designed to give engineers, product managers, and business leads the ability to ship fast - and safely.</p> <p>We are looking for a <strong><em>Senior Controls Product Manager</em></strong> to join our newly established Controls Product & Enablement team within our Controls Discipline. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering, you will act as the Product Lead for Monzo’s core risk lifecycles (Issues, RCSAs, Controls, Policy, Reg Traceability). </p> <p>You won't just write requirement docs for someone else to build - you are a builder yourself. You’ll prototype low-code tools, leverage AI models, interrogate data pipelines, and architect automated workflows to turn manual risk friction into seamless, automated self-service.</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Controls team</strong></p> <p>The role will sit within the <em>Controls Product & Enablement</em> team which is part of the wider Controls Discipline  in Monzo’s 1st line of defence  Our teams work closely with cross-functional teams across the organisation including Technology, Data, Product, Operations as well and Risk & Compliance (the 2nd line of defence).  </p> <p>As this is a newly established team (wherein you’ll have two direct reports already working in the team as data and automation specialists), this role holder needs to bring a flexible and adaptable mindset, as well as a willingness to deal with ambiguity as the team establishes its operating rhythm and embeds itself within the wider business.</p> <p><strong>🔑 What you’ll do (Your Product Ownership Scope)…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the Controls Product Roadmap: Define the vision, strategy, and backlog for Monzo’s internal risk products, replacing static, manual cycles with smart, data-driven platforms (SmartSuite, Zango, Looker, and native AI integrations).</li> <li>Hands-on Prototyping & Automation: Directly design, prototype, and build automated workflows, API integrations, and low-code/no-code solutions. You'll take an idea from a problem statement to a working MVP before partnering with core Engineering (if necessary) to scale or industrialise it.</li> <li>Pioneer AI in Risk Management: Champion AI adoption across the discipline. Experiment with LLM prompting, custom agents, and automated evidence-gathering tools to solve complex control problems and dramatically reduce manual drag for Monzo staff.</li> <li>Build for Real-Time Risk Intelligence: Drive the shift from annual "point-in-time" assessments to continuous, automated monitoring. Design data triggers (e.g., incident spikes, change flags) that alert risk owners in real time.</li> <li>Product Enablement & Adoption: Ensure high-impact adoption. Work closely with first line risk owners and Risk Partners to deliver clear "write once" guidance, intuitive UI/UX workflows, and enablement that allows teams to self-serve effortlessly.</li> <li>Drive Execution & Delivery: Maintain momentum across the team’s delivery plan (guiding 2 specialised data/automation direct reports), keeping senior stakeholders engaged and removing blockers without bureaucratic overhead.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You think like a Product Manager: You obsess over user problems, value vs. effort prioritization, user experience, and shipping MVPs quickly.</li> <li>You are a Hands-On Builder: You can get under the hood with data and automation. You're comfortable with SQL, Python (or similar), APIs, workflow tools, or low-code environments to build a working prototype yourself.</li> <li>You’re AI-Curious & Practical: You actively experiment with AI/LLMs to automate manual tasks and make workflows smarter.</li> <li>You Understand Risk & Controls: You understand fundamental risk concepts (control design, RCSAs, issue management) and see the massive opportunity to transform them through tech.</li> <li>You Thrive in Ambiguity: You enjoy starting from first principles in a fast-paced environment and turning messy operational problems into slick, scalable digital solutions.</li> <li>You have experience in leading teams through change programmes, ideally within Financial Services Controls functions.</li> <li>You are hands-on and take satisfaction in supporting colleagues, projects or tasks however big or small - and can take a range of stakeholders on the journey with you</li> <li>You’re excited by what we’re doing at Monzo</li> </ul> <h3><strong>ℹ️ This role </strong><strong><em>isn’t </em></strong><strong>for you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Your technology and data experience has primarily involved defining requirements for Data or Engineering teams to build, rather than building solutions yourself.</li> <li>You aren't comfortable getting hands-on with data, automation tooling and technical problem solving.</li> <li>You aren’t comfortable with ambiguity, or thinking from first principles</li> <li>You don’t enjoy working in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>You aren’t happy taking an MVP approach and doing what’s good enough for now with iterative changes to follow</li> <li>Equally, if your experience is primarily technical and you don't have sufficient understanding of risk and controls to translate control problems into effective solutions, this role is unlikely to be the right fit.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £85,000 - £115,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong><br>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short call with a Monzo Recruiter</li> <li>Video-call with Hiring Manager (30 mins)</li> <li>Full-Loop: 3 x video-call interviews (covering Technical, Behaviours, and Leadership)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>⏳<strong>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </strong></p> <p><strong><br></strong>#LI-REMOTE<br>#CM-1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Credit Model Validation Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!</p> <p>Our Credit Model Validation team provides independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence. We help Monzo grow safely and make sure the models we use are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and deliver good outcomes for our customers. You’ll join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across a broad suite of credit models.</p> <p>This is a generalist role rather than one focused on a particular model type. You’ll work across models used for impairment, capital, stress testing, forecasting and credit decisioning, including IFRS 9 PD, LGD, EAD and economic response models; decision science scorecards and origination PD models; and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models.</p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is broad expertise in credit risk modelling and model risk management. You’ll have hands-on experience in model validation and/or development within financial services, and be comfortable getting into the data and code to form an independent view across different model types.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day   </strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading hands-on independent validation across Monzo’s credit model portfolio - covering models used for IFRS 9 impairment, capital and stress testing, forecasting, credit decisioning and unit economics - and making sure they are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and performing as expected</li> <li>Reviewing and challenging key model-led credit risk assessments, including impairment adequacy, ICAAP and stress testing, using independent analysis to assess assumptions, limitations and impacts</li> <li>Developing a deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models and how they are used, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers and users</li> <li>Contributing to making model validation more consistent, scalable and technology-enabled - building reusable analytical tools and tests, experimenting with AI-assisted approaches and helping the team embed them safely</li> <li>Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required</li> <li>Performing statistical analyses, model replication and challenger work where appropriate to test assumptions, assess performance and strengthen validation conclusions</li> <li>Improving and helping to embed our Model Risk Framework, including our policies, standards, model inventory, governance and validation approach. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory expectations and that our processes remain proportionate and relevant as modelling techniques evolve</li> <li>Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees</li> <li>Partnering with colleagues in first line of defence credit strategy, modelling and finance teams - and with wider risk teams across Monzo - to support effective model governance and consistent validation standards across the organisation</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You should apply if you:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation across a range of model types. You’ll have meaningful experience with IFRS 9 impairment, Internal Ratings Based (IRB) or other capital models, alongside broader exposure to several areas such as stress testing, economic response, forecasting, decision science scorecards or NPV / unit economics modelling</li> <li>Understand model risk management in practice, including independent validation, model governance, ongoing monitoring, model change and issue management, and how regulatory expectations apply across the model lifecycle</li> <li>Are impact-driven and want to improve how validation is done, not only complete individual reviews. You can turn repeatable work into practical methods, tools or guidance that improve quality and consistency across the team.</li> <li>Are curious about AI and automation, and can assess where they add value, the risks they introduce, and the controls and human oversight needed. Experience with AI-assisted analytical or coding tools is useful, but not essential</li> <li>Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep knowledge of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Strong SQL and Python skills are essential. You can produce clear, reusable and tested code, using collaborative practices such as version control, peer review and documentation. Experience with Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus.</li> <li>Can assess models in the context of how they are used - including accounting, capital, credit strategy, risk appetite and customer outcomes - and can distinguish technical model performance from the wider risks of relying on the model</li> <li>Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. This is particularly important for breaking down complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and can provide effective and respectful challenge</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our technology stack</strong></p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"> BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and machine learning</li> <li><a href="http://golang.org/">Go</a> to write our application code</li> <li><a href="http://aws.amazon.com/">AWS</a> for most of our backend infrastructure</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The interview process:</strong></h3> <p>Our interview process usually involves up to four main stages via Google Meet: </p> <ul> <li>An initial call with our recruiter</li> <li>A call with our Senior Model Validation Manager, the hiring manager for the role </li> <li>A role-specific call with colleagues from our credit modelling and model risk teams. We’ll share a short case study in advance, but you won’t need to submit a written response; we’ll use it to guide the discussion during the interview.</li> <li>A behavioural interview<br><br> <ul> <li> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> </li> <ul> <li>💰 £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance benefits.<br><br></li> <li>📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).<br><br></li> <li>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.<br><br></li> <li>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.<br><br></li> <li>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.<br><br></li> <li>➕ Plus lots more! Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK)  | 💰 £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>🌟 About the team:</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!</p> <p>Our Credit Model Validation team is crucial in providing independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely and ensure that the models we use deliver good outcomes for our customers. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) to join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across our suite of credit models, covering critical business disciplines such as credit strategy and impairment.</p> <p>You’ll have a particular focus on models used for customer-level decisioning and defining our credit strategies - such as underwriting scorecards, origination PD models and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models - across all our lending products.</p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is deep expertise in credit risk modelling. You’ll have hands-on experience in either model validation or model development within a financial services environment, including practical experience using Python to develop, validate or analyse machine learning and statistical models. . In-depth knowledge of credit decisioning models would be a strong plus. </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading hands-on independent validation of models used for credit decisioning within our Borrowing strategies - covering a range of machine learning, decision science and NPV models. You will be ensuring that models are fit for purpose, appropriately governed, explainable and performing as expected</li> <li>Supporting oversight and validation of broader credit risk models, including IFRS9, stress testing and economic response models</li> <li>Developing deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers to improve our modelling capabilities</li> <li>Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required</li> <li>Performing statistical analyses to independently assess model performance, including developing challenger models where appropriate to test model assumptions and strengthen validation conclusions</li> <li>Improving our Model Risk Framework, including overseeing our policies, standards and procedures to help embed best practice across the business. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory guidelines, and adapt our processes to make sure they remain relevant as modelling techniques evolve</li> <li>Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees</li> <li>Partnering with colleagues in the first line of defence credit strategy and modelling teams - and wider risk teams across Monzo - to support the embedding of our model risk framework and establishing consistent validation standards across the organisation</li> <li>Embracing new and innovative technology, including leading the adoption of AI tools to enhance our model validation approach</li> </ul> <p><strong> 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation - in particular with exposure to machine learning or statistical models used in credit decisioning, such as decision science scorecards, origination / underwriting PD models, and NPV / unit economics modelling</li> <li>Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep understanding of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Being able to get hands on with data is critical - so strong SQL and Python skills are essential, and experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus!</li> <li>Understand how models are used in real-time decisioning and lending strategies, and how to balance commercial and risk outcomes</li> <li>Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. This is particularly important for breaking down complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and can provide effective and respectful challenge</li> <li>Are impact-driven, and proactive in identifying issues and opportunities to improve outcomes for both our customers and our business</li> <li>Are passionate about technology, and what we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our technology stack</strong></p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"> BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and machine learning</li> <li><a href="http://golang.org/">Go</a> to write our application code</li> <li><a href="http://aws.amazon.com/">AWS</a> for most of our backend infrastructure</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process: </strong></p> <p>Our interview process usually involves up to four main stages via Google Hangouts: </p> <ul> <li>An initial call with our recruiter</li> <li>A call with our Senior Model Validation Manager, the hiring manager for the role </li> <li>A role-specific call with colleagues from our credit modelling teams. We’ll share a short case study in advance, but you won’t need to submit a written response; we’ll use it to guide the discussion during the interview.</li> <li>A behavioural interview <br><br> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> </li> <ul> <li>💰 £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance benefits.<br><br></li> <li>📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).<br><br></li> <li>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.<br><br></li> <li>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.<br><br></li> <li>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.<br><br></li> <li>➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of <a href="https://monzo.com/careers">benefits</a>.<br><br></li> </ul> </ul> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage, so please apply as soon as you can - we don’t want you to miss out!<br><br>LinkedIn Tags: <strong>#LI-TK1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.</p> <p>Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.</p> <p> </p> <h4><strong>Our EU team ⭐</strong></h4> <p>Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo. </p> <p> </p> <p>Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.</p> <p> </p> <p>You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.</p> <p><em>Shaping product and commercial strategy:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.</li> <li>You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.</li> </ul> <p><em>Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.</li> <li>Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.</li> </ul> <p><em>Changing how decisions get made:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.</li> <li>You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.</li> </ul> <p><em>Building and leading a high-performing team:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.</li> <li>You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <p>What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe especially so!</p> <ul> <li>You're a strategic data leader who has operated at Director level or above, and you're energised by zero-to-one ambiguity, having built or scaled a data function in a new market, product line or business from an early stage.</li> <li>You move comfortably from detailed metrics and data architecture to customer strategy, commercial outcomes and product-market fit, and you're happy to be the opinionated voice in the room that reframes the trade-off.</li> <li>You lead through learning loops and hold a high technical bar, because you've built or owned the measurement a business relies on to set goals, run experiments and improve, with the judgement to know which methods and investments will pay off.</li> <li>You have experience leading company-wide or division-wide goal-setting, defining high-clarity metrics, setting targets and partnering closely with Finance.</li> <li>You change how organisations make decisions, not just how one project turns out, and you have experience of the cross-collective collaboration that connects the dots across different business areas.</li> <li>You're an empathetic people leader who has grown full-stack Data teams of both individual contributors and managers, comfortable representing Data at ExCo and to C-level peers, and you know what it takes to attract, develop and retain top talent.</li> </ul> and transparency that defines the brand today.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to help shape Monzo’s payments strategy to make Monzo's global ambitions a reality, and challenge thinking</li> <li>Identify untapped opportunities for commercial optimisation, including across pricing, commercialisation, investment and customer growth</li> <li>Set the data strategy teams make clear, high-impact decisions</li> <li>Develop and scale a high-performing team of data professionals sharing accountability for product and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You <li>You combine deep Data expertise with strong product and commercial judgement. </li> <li>You can move comfortably from detailed metrics or architecture discussions to customer strategy, pricing and informal ~30 min recruiter call, our interview process involves 2 main stages. across Europe.</p> <p>This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll work senior technical leaders.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.</li> <li>Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.</li> <li>Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.</li> <li>Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.</li> <li>Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.</li> <li>Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.</li> <li>Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.</li> <li>Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You should apply if</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.</li> <li>You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.</li> <li>You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.</li> <li>You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.</li> <li>You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.</li> <li>You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.</li> <li>You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.</li> <li>You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.</li> <li>You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The interview process</strong></h3> <p>After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages: </p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage</strong> - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.</li> </ol> <p>At all stages we’ll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you’re interviewing us as well!</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a>. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.<br><br></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working (If you're in the UK) : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <h3><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas for the UK (not Spain)</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 ( a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. Our product <em>is</em> our personality. We blend research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.</p> <p>Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.</p> <p>Applying to this role, you’ll be in a standard hiring process for a Lead Product Designer, and we’ll find the perfect team for you along the way. </p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tackling the most complex and ambiguous design challenges, turning complexity into elegant, scalable solutions that empower teams and improve the customer experience.</li> <li>Defining and delivering large-scale projects that connect initiatives across the business, using design methods to align strategies and drive impactful outcomes.</li> <li>Leading the creation of compelling product visions, principles, and direction that inspire teams to build toward a shared future.</li> <li>Using AI to level-up parts of your design workflow. Whether that’s ideation, analysis, prototyping or shipping production code to our app.</li> <li>Raising the bar for visual execution, considering motion, interaction, and mental model clarity to deliver delightful and practical solutions.</li> <li>Positively influencing our design system, tooling, and processes to improve how we create design at scale.</li> <li>Driving improvements across the business by connecting your work to wider goals and leveraging cross-functional collaboration.</li> <li>Acting as a role model in Design, sharing your work broadly, mentoring others, and contributing to the growth and success of the Design team.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of delivering impactful, customer-centric native-app designs that solve complex problems and drive commercial outcomes.</li> <li>You’re skilled at leading research, defining product visions, and aligning teams around a shared strategy.</li> <li>You excel at creating modular, scalable solutions and have a strong grasp of how to use design artefacts to communicate insights effectively.</li> <li>You’re a natural collaborator who can navigate multi-squad projects, align leadership, and drive clarity in ambiguous situations.</li> <li>You’re passionate about improving design systems, processes, and ways of working to help teams deliver better outcomes at scale.</li> <li>You’re a role model who actively contributes to the growth of the Design team through hiring, mentoring, and fostering a positive culture.</li> <li>You’re excited about Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone and are ready to make a significant impact on our customers and business.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!</p> <p> </p> <p>🌈<strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>30-minute call with our Recruiter</li> <li>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Design team</li> <li>2 x 45-minute interviews covering Teamwork and Impact</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>This process should take around 4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. You will share best practice that is easy for everyone to understand.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> <li>You are self-motivated and thrive in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>You have great attention to detail while keeping an eye on the big picture</li> <li>You are a great communicator, able to articulate complex problems</li> <li>You can provide effective challenge whilst building strong, respectful relationships</li> <li>You are keen to grow your knowledge in both business and technology</li> </ul> <p><strong>And, from a technical and knowledge perspective, you should have</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>Robust Data Science or Machine Learning background with strong Python capability</li> <li>Experience with design of Generative AI evaluation frameworks, architectures, methods, practical tooling and platform alignment.</li> <li>Knowledge of Gemini implementations and change assessment</li> <li>Experience of managing a modelling project through its full lifecycle</li> <li>If possible, some understanding of some of the following:</li> <ul> <li>Coaching and standard setting</li> <li>Banking MRM and regulatory context</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£85,000 - If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.</p> <p>This is a player/coach role. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or UK Remote | 💰<a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-0.pdf"> Senior Engineer (L50)</a> £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a> - Engineering  </p> <p><strong>About our Engineering Teams:</strong></p> <p>We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.</p> <p>These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.</p> <p>We contribute to <a href="https://github.com/monzo"><strong>open source software</strong></a> as much as possible. Our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"><strong>blog</strong></a><strong> </strong>is a good place to learn even more about what we do!</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day   </strong></p> <p>This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! </p> <p>Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.</p> <p>They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! </p> <p>Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻</strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️</p> <p>Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.</p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</li> <li>you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</li> <li>you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</li> <li>you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</li> </ul> <p>We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">Engineering Progression Framework </a>- we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters! </p> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on: </strong></p> <p>We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: </p> <ul> <li><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a> to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial <a href="https://tour.golang.org/welcome/1"><strong>here</strong></a>)</li> <li><a href="http://cassandra.apache.org/"><strong>Cassandra</strong></a> for most persistent data storage</li> <li><a href="http://kafka.apache.org/"><strong>Kafka</strong></a> for our asynchronous message queue</li> <li><a href="http://kubernetes.io/"><strong>Kubernetes</strong></a> and <a href="https://www.docker.com/"><strong>Docker</strong></a> to schedule and run our services </li> <li><a actual cables to connect to various third parties</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages: </p> <ol> <li>Initial Call </li> <li>Take home task or pair coding exercise </li> <li>Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview </li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/23/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process"><strong>here</strong></a>.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>✈️We can help you relocate to the UK </p> <p>✅We can sponsor visas.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a Given the stage Monzo is currently at in its growth journey, these will be many and wide ranging, from customer products to treasury strategies, group reorgs to mobility proposals, systems implementations to international expansion.</p> <p><strong>🔑 Key responsibilities of the role...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Global tax strategy:</strong> Defining how Monzo approaches tax across the UK, Europe, and future markets. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> <strong><br><br>About the Role </strong></p> <p>This role is for a Senior Engineering Manager where you’ll be a manager of managers. You will be leading across multiple teams in an org of around 20-30 people. We’re expanding and your role as the Senior EM will be to grow and build new squads as needed. Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers.<br><br>Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.</p> <p>Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.</p> <p>You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-manager-framework-v2-0.pdf">Progression Framework</a>.</p> <p><strong>Is this role right for you?</strong></p> <p>While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.</p> <p>We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery and Execution</strong>: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.</li> <li><strong>Engineering and Operational Excellence</strong>: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.</li> <li><strong>People Leadership:</strong> Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.</li> <li><strong>Technical Influence:</strong> Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Relationships:</strong> Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Organisational Wide Impact:</strong> Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.</li> </ul> <p><em>We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so </em><strong><em>if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.<br><br></em></strong></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <p>After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)<br><br></li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).</li> </ol> <p>The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:</p> <p><em>- Team and Org Management (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.</p> <p><em>- System Design (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.</p> <p><em>- Behavioural (1 hour)</em><em><br></em>Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.</p> <p><em>- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)</em><em><br></em>At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. </p> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> </p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a><br><br>#LI-Remote #LI-AL1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

The Financial Crime & Fraud Collective is at the heart of this work. As a Senior Fraud Risk Manager, you’ll lead the charge in keeping fraudsters at bay so our customers can bank with total confidence!</p> <p>You’ll get to work across current accounts, business banking, international accounts, and more. While you’ll be managing people and programs, you should also be excited to roll up your sleeves and get hands-on.</p> <p>We need a crack team of crime fighters to help us stay one step ahead as we continue to grow. <br><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>Helping to lead our fast-growing global Fraud & Disputes Risk team and work alongside leaders across our cross-functional Fraud Squads. We’re looking for a proactive, collaborative leader who really knows fraud risk management inside and out - spanning several of our authorised fraud, unauthorised fraud, first-party fraud, and disputes specialisms</p> <p>You’ll build great relationships with our Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations teams to design smooth, effective fraud controls, investigation processes, and reporting. You’ll also champion a positive team culture and make sure key fraud initiatives stay on track.</p> <p>Your Core Focus Areas include<strong>:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Fraud Strategy & Operational Execution:</strong> Join squad leadership to turn our big-picture fraud vision into practical roadmaps for our UK and EU Banks. You’ll strike the perfect balance between smart protection controls and a seamless customer experience.</li> <li><strong>Control Framework & Fraud SME:</strong> Be our go-to expert on fraud typologies and prevention tools, overseeing end-to-end design and rollout of strong controls.</li> <li><strong>Threat Intelligence & Performance Analytics:</strong> Embed data and threat monitoring to catch new fraud trends early, turning insights into quick control improvements.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Coordination:</strong> Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Ops to keep initiatives aligned and moving forward.</li> <li><strong>People Leadership & Capability Building</strong>: Coach, mentor, and grow a fantastic fraud risk team while supporting everyone’s personal and professional development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience leading fraud strategy and risk teams, ideally in a fast-moving, regulated environment.</li> <li>You know UK & EU fraud regulations inside out.</li> <li>You’re skilled at building tech-driven fraud strategies that scale across operations.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of delivering end-to-end projects and large-scale change programs.</li> <li>You stay plugged into industry trends and can quickly respond to new fraud risks.</li> <li>You excel at balancing fraud risk with business goals and collaborating to ship new products safely.</li> <li>You’re a supportive coach who loves developing high-performing teams.</li> <li>You’re an empathetic communicator who aligns messaging with our core values.</li> <li>You’re data-driven, comfortable self-serving data, and love using tech to solve problems.</li> <li>You hold a relevant industry qualification (such as ICA, Cifas, ACAMS, or CFE).<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £108,700 - £140,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>30 min call with the recruiter</li> <li>30 min hiring manager call</li> <li>2 hours of technical and leadership principle interviews</li> </ul> <p><br>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-OS1 #LI-REMOTE<strong><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo.
